1module clubb_intr
2
3 !----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
4 ! Module to interface CAM with Cloud Layers Unified by Bi-normals (CLUBB), developed !
5 ! by the University of Wisconsin Milwaukee Group (UWM). !
6 ! !
7 ! CLUBB replaces the exisiting turbulence, shallow convection, and macrophysics in CAM5 !
8 ! !
9 ! Lastly, a implicit diffusion solver is called, and tendencies retrieved by !
10 ! differencing the diffused and initial states. !
11 ! !
12 ! Calling sequence: !
13 ! !
14 !---------------------------Code history-------------------------------------------------------------- !
15 ! Authors: P. Bogenschutz, C. Craig, A. Gettelman !
16 ! !
17 !----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !

185 subroutine clubb_register_cam( )
186!-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
187! Description:
188! Register the constituents and fields in the physics buffer
189! Author: P. Bogenschutz, C. Craig, A. Gettelman
190!
191!-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
192#ifdef CLUBB_SGS
193
194 !------------------------------------------------ !
195 ! Register physics buffer fields and constituents !
196 !------------------------------------------------ !
197
198 ! Add CLUBB fields to pbuf
199 use physics_buffer, only: pbuf_add_field, dtype_r8, dyn_time_lvls
200 use ppgrid, only: pver, pverp, pcols
201
202 call phys_getopts( eddy_scheme_out = eddy_scheme, &
203 deep_scheme_out = deep_scheme, &
204 do_tms_out = do_tms, &
205 history_budget_out = history_budget, &
206 history_budget_histfile_num_out = history_budget_histfile_num, &
207 micro_do_icesupersat_out = micro_do_icesupersat)
208
209 if (clubb_do_adv) then
210 cnst_names =(/'THLP2 ','RTP2 ','RTPTHLP','WPTHLP ','WPRTP ','WP2 ','WP3 ','UP2 ','VP2 '/)
211 do_cnst=.true.
212 ! If CLUBB moments are advected, do not output them automatically which is typically done. Some moments
213 ! need a constant added to them before they are advected, thus this would corrupt the output.
214 ! Users should refer to the "XXXX_CLUBB" (THLP2_CLUBB for instance) output variables for these moments
215 call cnst_add(trim(cnst_names(1)),0._r8,0._r8,0._r8,ixthlp2,longname='second moment vertical velocity',cam_outfld=.false.)
216 call cnst_add(trim(cnst_names(2)),0._r8,0._r8,0._r8,ixrtp2,longname='second moment rtp',cam_outfld=.false.)
217 call cnst_add(trim(cnst_names(3)),0._r8,0._r8,-999999._r8,ixrtpthlp,longname='covariance rtp thlp',cam_outfld=.false.)
218 call cnst_add(trim(cnst_names(4)),0._r8,0._r8,-999999._r8,ixwpthlp,longname='CLUBB heat flux',cam_outfld=.false.)
219 call cnst_add(trim(cnst_names(5)),0._r8,0._r8,-999999._r8,ixwprtp,longname='CLUBB moisture flux',cam_outfld=.false.)
220 call cnst_add(trim(cnst_names(6)),0._r8,0._r8,0._r8,ixwp2,longname='CLUBB wp2',cam_outfld=.false.)
221 call cnst_add(trim(cnst_names(7)),0._r8,0._r8,-999999._r8,ixwp3,longname='CLUBB 3rd moment vert velocity',cam_outfld=.false.)
222 call cnst_add(trim(cnst_names(8)),0._r8,0._r8,0._r8,ixup2,longname='CLUBB 2nd moment u wind',cam_outfld=.false.)
223 call cnst_add(trim(cnst_names(9)),0._r8,0._r8,0._r8,ixvp2,longname='CLUBB 2nd moment v wind',cam_outfld=.false.)
224 end if
225
226 ! put pbuf_add calls here (see macrop_driver.F90 for sample) use indicies defined at top
227 call pbuf_add_field('pblh', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols/), pblh_idx)
228 call pbuf_add_field('tke', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols, pverp/), tke_idx)
229 call pbuf_add_field('kvh', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols, pverp/), kvh_idx)
230 call pbuf_add_field('kvm', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols, pverp/), kvm_idx)
231 call pbuf_add_field('tpert', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols/), tpert_idx)
232 call pbuf_add_field('AST', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols,pver,dyn_time_lvls/), ast_idx)
233 call pbuf_add_field('AIST', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols,pver,dyn_time_lvls/), aist_idx)
234 call pbuf_add_field('ALST', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols,pver,dyn_time_lvls/), alst_idx)
235 call pbuf_add_field('QIST', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols,pver,dyn_time_lvls/), qist_idx)
236 call pbuf_add_field('QLST', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols,pver,dyn_time_lvls/), qlst_idx)
237 call pbuf_add_field('CONCLD', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols,pver,dyn_time_lvls/), concld_idx)
238 call pbuf_add_field('CLD', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols,pver,dyn_time_lvls/), cld_idx)
239 call pbuf_add_field('FICE', 'physpkg',dtype_r8, (/pcols,pver/), fice_idx)
240 call pbuf_add_field('RAD_CLUBB', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols,pver/), radf_idx)
241 call pbuf_add_field('CMELIQ', 'physpkg',dtype_r8, (/pcols,pver/), cmeliq_idx)
242
243 call pbuf_add_field('WP2_nadv', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols,pverp,dyn_time_lvls/), wp2_idx)
244 call pbuf_add_field('WP3_nadv', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols,pverp,dyn_time_lvls/), wp3_idx)
245 call pbuf_add_field('WPTHLP_nadv', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols,pverp,dyn_time_lvls/), wpthlp_idx)
246 call pbuf_add_field('WPRTP_nadv', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols,pverp,dyn_time_lvls/), wprtp_idx)
247 call pbuf_add_field('RTPTHLP_nadv', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols,pverp,dyn_time_lvls/), rtpthlp_idx)
248 call pbuf_add_field('RTP2_nadv', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols,pverp,dyn_time_lvls/), rtp2_idx)
249 call pbuf_add_field('THLP2_nadv', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols,pverp,dyn_time_lvls/), thlp2_idx)
250 call pbuf_add_field('UP2_nadv', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols,pverp,dyn_time_lvls/), up2_idx)
251 call pbuf_add_field('VP2_nadv', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols,pverp,dyn_time_lvls/), vp2_idx)
252
253 call pbuf_add_field('UPWP', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols,pverp,dyn_time_lvls/), upwp_idx)
254 call pbuf_add_field('VPWP', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols,pverp,dyn_time_lvls/), vpwp_idx)
255 call pbuf_add_field('THLM', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols,pverp,dyn_time_lvls/), thlm_idx)
256 call pbuf_add_field('RTM', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols,pverp,dyn_time_lvls/), rtm_idx)
257 call pbuf_add_field('UM', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols,pverp,dyn_time_lvls/), um_idx)
258 call pbuf_add_field('VM', 'global', dtype_r8, (/pcols,pverp,dyn_time_lvls/), vm_idx)
259
260#endif
261
262 end subroutine clubb_register_cam

289subroutine clubb_init_cnst(name, q, gcid)
290
291#ifdef CLUBB_SGS
292 use constants_clubb, only: w_tol_sqd, rt_tol, thl_tol
293#endif
294
295 !----------------------------------------------------------------------- !
296 ! !
297 ! Initialize the state if clubb_do_adv !
298 ! !
299 !----------------------------------------------------------------------- !
300
301 character(len=*), intent(in) :: name ! constituent name
302 real(r8), intent(out) :: q(:,:) ! mass mixing ratio (gcol, plev)
303 integer, intent(in) :: gcid(:) ! global column id
304 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
305
306#ifdef CLUBB_SGS
307 if (clubb_do_adv) then
308 if (trim(name) == trim(cnst_names(1))) q = thl_tol**2
309 if (trim(name) == trim(cnst_names(2))) q = rt_tol**2
310 if (trim(name) == trim(cnst_names(3))) q = 0.0_r8
311 if (trim(name) == trim(cnst_names(4))) q = 0.0_r8
312 if (trim(name) == trim(cnst_names(5))) q = 0.0_r8
313 if (trim(name) == trim(cnst_names(6))) q = w_tol_sqd
314 if (trim(name) == trim(cnst_names(7))) q = 0.0_r8
315 if (trim(name) == trim(cnst_names(8))) q = w_tol_sqd
316 if (trim(name) == trim(cnst_names(9))) q = w_tol_sqd
317 end if
318#endif
319
320end subroutine clubb_init_cnst

327512512 subroutine clubb_readnl(nlfile)
328
329#ifdef CLUBB_SGS
330 use namelist_utils, only: find_group_name
331 use units, only: getunit, freeunit
332 use cam_abortutils, only: endrun
333 use stats_variables, only: l_stats, l_output_rad_files
334 use mpishorthand
335#endif
336
337 character(len=*), intent(in) :: nlfile ! filepath for file containing namelist input
338
339#ifdef CLUBB_SGS
340 logical :: clubb_history, clubb_rad_history, clubb_cloudtop_cooling, clubb_rainevap_turb, clubb_expldiff ! Stats enabled (T/F)
341
342 integer :: iunit, read_status
343
344 namelist /clubb_his_nl/ clubb_history, clubb_rad_history
345 namelist /clubbpbl_diff_nl/ clubb_cloudtop_cooling, clubb_rainevap_turb, clubb_expldiff, clubb_do_adv, clubb_do_deep
346
347 !----- Begin Code -----
348
349 ! Determine if we want clubb_history to be output
350 clubb_history = .false. ! Initialize to false
351 l_stats = .false. ! Initialize to false
352 l_output_rad_files = .false. ! Initialize to false
353 do_cldcool = .false. ! Initialize to false
354 do_rainturb = .false. ! Initialize to false
355 do_expldiff = .false. ! Initialize to false
356
357
358 ! Read namelist to determine if CLUBB history should be called
359 if (masterproc) then
360 iunit = getunit()
361 open( iunit, file=trim(nlfile), status='old' )
362
363 call find_group_name(iunit, 'clubb_his_nl', status=read_status)
364 if (read_status == 0) then
365 read(unit=iunit, nml=clubb_his_nl, iostat=read_status)
366 if (read_status /= 0) then
367 call endrun('clubb_readnl: error reading namelist')
368 end if
369 end if
370
371 call find_group_name(iunit, 'clubbpbl_diff_nl', status=read_status)
372 if (read_status == 0) then
373 read(unit=iunit, nml=clubbpbl_diff_nl, iostat=read_status)
374 if (read_status /= 0) then
375 call endrun('clubb_readnl: error reading namelist')
376 end if
377 end if
378
379 close(unit=iunit)
380 call freeunit(iunit)
381 end if
382
383#ifdef SPMD
384! Broadcast namelist variables
385 call mpibcast(clubb_history, 1, mpilog, 0, mpicom)
386 call mpibcast(clubb_rad_history, 1, mpilog, 0, mpicom)
387 call mpibcast(clubb_cloudtop_cooling, 1, mpilog, 0, mpicom)
388 call mpibcast(clubb_rainevap_turb, 1, mpilog, 0, mpicom)
389 call mpibcast(clubb_expldiff, 1, mpilog, 0, mpicom)
390 call mpibcast(clubb_do_adv, 1, mpilog, 0, mpicom)
391 call mpibcast(clubb_do_deep, 1, mpilog, 0, mpicom)
392#endif
393
394 ! Overwrite defaults if they are true
395 if (clubb_history) l_stats = .true.
396 if (clubb_rad_history) l_output_rad_files = .true.
397 if (clubb_cloudtop_cooling) do_cldcool = .true.
398 if (clubb_rainevap_turb) do_rainturb = .true.
399 if (clubb_expldiff) do_expldiff = .true.
400
401#endif
402512512 end subroutine clubb_readnl

408 subroutine clubb_ini_cam(pbuf2d)
409!-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
410! Description:
411! Initialize UWM CLUBB.
412! Author: Cheryl Craig March 2011
413! Modifications: Pete Bogenschutz 2011 March and onward
414! Origin: Based heavily on UWM clubb_init.F90
415! References:
416! None
417!-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
418
419
420
421#ifdef CLUBB_SGS
422
423 ! From CAM libraries
424 use physics_types, only: physics_state, physics_ptend
425 use cam_history, only: addfld, add_default, phys_decomp
426 use ppgrid, only: pver, pverp, pcols
427 use ref_pres, only: pref_mid
428 use hb_diff, only: init_hb_diff
429 use trb_mtn_stress, only: init_tms
430 use rad_constituents, only: rad_cnst_get_info, rad_cnst_get_mode_num_idx, rad_cnst_get_mam_mmr_idx
431
432 ! From the CLUBB libraries
433 use clubb_core, only: setup_clubb_core
434 use clubb_precision, only: time_precision
435 use error_code, only: set_clubb_debug_level ! Subroutines
436 use parameter_indices, only: nparams ! Constant
437 use parameters_tunable, only: read_parameters ! Subroutine
438 use stats_variables, only: l_stats, l_stats_samp, l_grads, l_output_rad_files, &
439 zt, zm, sfc, rad_zt, rad_zm
440 use units, only: getunit, freeunit
441 use error_messages, only: handle_errmsg
442 use time_manager, only: is_first_step
443 use constants_clubb, only: w_tol_sqd, rt_tol, thl_tol
444
445
446 ! These are only needed if we're using a passive scalar
447 use array_index, only: iisclr_rt, iisclr_thl, iisclr_CO2, & ! [kg/kg]/[K]/[1e6 mol/mol]
448 iiedsclr_rt, iiedsclr_thl, iiedsclr_CO2 ! " "
449 use constituents, only: cnst_get_ind
450 use phys_control, only: phys_getopts
451
452#endif
453
454 use physics_buffer, only: pbuf_get_index, pbuf_set_field, physics_buffer_desc
455 implicit none
456 ! Input Variables
457 type(physics_buffer_desc), pointer :: pbuf2d(:,:)
458
459#ifdef CLUBB_SGS
460
461 real(kind=time_precision) :: dum1, dum2, dum3
462
463 real(8), dimension(nparams) :: clubb_params ! These adjustable CLUBB parameters (C1, C2 ...)
464
465 logical :: clubb_history, clubb_rad_history, clubb_cloudtop_cooling, clubb_rainevap_turb, clubb_expldiff ! Stats enabled (T/F)
466
467 ! The similar name to clubb_history is unfortunate...
468 logical :: history_amwg, history_clubb
469
470 character(len=128) :: errstring ! error status for CLUBB init
471
472 integer :: err_code, iunit ! Code for when CLUBB fails
473 integer :: i, j, k, l ! Indices
474 integer :: read_status ! Length of a string
475 integer :: ntop_eddy ! Top interface level to which eddy vertical diffusion is applied ( = 1 )
476 integer :: nbot_eddy ! Bottom interface level to which eddy vertical diffusion is applied ( = pver )
477 integer :: nmodes, nspec, pmam_ncnst, m
478 integer :: ixnumliq
479 integer :: lptr
480
481 real(r8) :: zt_g(pverp) ! Height dummy array
482 real(r8) :: zi_g(pverp) ! Height dummy array
483
484
485 !----- Begin Code -----
486
487 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------- !
488 ! Determine how many constituents CLUBB will transport. Note that
489 ! CLUBB does not transport aerosol consituents. Therefore, need to
490 ! determine how many aerosols constituents there are and subtract that
491 ! off of pcnst (the total consituents)
492 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------- !
493
494 call phys_getopts(prog_modal_aero_out=prog_modal_aero, &
495 history_amwg_out=history_amwg, &
496 history_clubb_out=history_clubb)
497
498 ! Select variables to apply tendencies back to CAM
499
500 ! Initialize all consituents to true to start
501 lq(1:pcnst) = .true.
502 edsclr_dim = pcnst
503
504 if (prog_modal_aero) then
505 ! Turn off modal aerosols and decrement edsclr_dim accordingly
506 call rad_cnst_get_info(0, nmodes=nmodes)
507
508 do m = 1, nmodes
509 call rad_cnst_get_mode_num_idx(m, lptr)
510 lq(lptr)=.false.
511 edsclr_dim = edsclr_dim-1
512
513 call rad_cnst_get_info(0, m, nspec=nspec)
514 do l = 1, nspec
515 call rad_cnst_get_mam_mmr_idx(m, l, lptr)
516 lq(lptr)=.false.
517 edsclr_dim = edsclr_dim-1
518 end do
519 end do
520
521 ! In addition, if running with MAM, droplet number is transported
522 ! in dropmixnuc, therefore we do NOT want CLUBB to apply transport
523 ! tendencies to avoid double counted. Else, we apply tendencies.
524 call cnst_get_ind('NUMLIQ',ixnumliq)
525 lq(ixnumliq) = .false.
526 edsclr_dim = edsclr_dim-1
527 endif
528
529 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------- !
530 ! Set the debug level. Level 2 has additional computational expense since
531 ! it checks the array variables in CLUBB for invalid values.
532 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------- !
533 call set_clubb_debug_level( 0 )
534
535 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------- !
536 ! use pbuf_get_fld_idx to get existing physics buffer fields from other
537 ! physics packages (e.g. tke)
538 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------- !
539
540
541 ! Defaults
542 l_stats_samp = .false.
543 l_grads = .false.
544
545 ! Overwrite defaults if needbe
546 if (l_stats) l_stats_samp = .true.
547
548 ! Define physics buffers indexes
549 cld_idx = pbuf_get_index('CLD') ! Cloud fraction
550 concld_idx = pbuf_get_index('CONCLD') ! Convective cloud cover
551 ast_idx = pbuf_get_index('AST') ! Stratiform cloud fraction
552 alst_idx = pbuf_get_index('ALST') ! Liquid stratiform cloud fraction
553 aist_idx = pbuf_get_index('AIST') ! Ice stratiform cloud fraction
554 qlst_idx = pbuf_get_index('QLST') ! Physical in-stratus LWC
555 qist_idx = pbuf_get_index('QIST') ! Physical in-stratus IWC
556 dp_frac_idx = pbuf_get_index('DP_FRAC') ! Deep convection cloud fraction
557 icwmrdp_idx = pbuf_get_index('ICWMRDP') ! In-cloud deep convective mixing ratio
558 sh_frac_idx = pbuf_get_index('SH_FRAC') ! Shallow convection cloud fraction
559 relvar_idx = pbuf_get_index('RELVAR') ! Relative cloud water variance
560 accre_enhan_idx = pbuf_get_index('ACCRE_ENHAN') ! accretion enhancement for MG
561 prer_evap_idx = pbuf_get_index('PRER_EVAP')
562 qrl_idx = pbuf_get_index('QRL')
563
564 iisclr_rt = -1
565 iisclr_thl = -1
566 iisclr_CO2 = -1
567
568 iiedsclr_rt = -1
569 iiedsclr_thl = -1
570 iiedsclr_CO2 = -1
571
572 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------- !
573 ! Define number of tracers for CLUBB to diffuse
574 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------- !
575
576 if (do_expldiff) then
577 offset = 2 ! diffuse temperature and moisture explicitly
578 edsclr_dim = edsclr_dim + offset
579 endif
580
581 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------- !
582 ! Setup CLUBB core
583 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------- !
584
585 ! Read in parameters for CLUBB. Just read in default values
586!$OMP PARALLEL
587 call read_parameters( -99, "", clubb_params )
588!$OMP END PARALLEL
589
590 ! Fill in dummy arrays for height. Note that these are overwrote
591 ! at every CLUBB step to physical values.
592 do k=1,pverp
593 zt_g(k) = ((k-1)*1000._r8)-500._r8 ! this is dummy garbage
594 zi_g(k) = (k-1)*1000._r8 ! this is dummy garbage
595 enddo
596
597 ! Set up CLUBB core. Note that some of these inputs are overwrote
598 ! when clubb_tend_cam is called. The reason is that heights can change
599 ! at each time step, which is why dummy arrays are read in here for heights
600 ! as they are immediately overwrote.
601!$OMP PARALLEL
602 call setup_clubb_core &
603 ( pverp, theta0, ts_nudge, & ! In
604 hydromet_dim, sclr_dim, & ! In
605 sclr_tol, edsclr_dim, clubb_params, & ! In
606 l_host_applies_sfc_fluxes, & ! In
607 l_uv_nudge, saturation_equation, & ! In
608 l_implemented, grid_type, zi_g(2), zi_g(1), zi_g(pverp), & ! In
609 zi_g(1:pverp), zt_g(1:pverp), & ! In
610 host_dx, host_dy, zi_g(1), & ! In
611 err_code )
612!$OMP END PARALLEL
613
614 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------- !
615 ! Set-up HB diffusion. Only initialized to diagnose PBL depth !
616 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------- !
617
618 ! Initialize eddy diffusivity module
619
620 ntop_eddy = 1 ! if >1, must be <= nbot_molec
621 nbot_eddy = pver ! currently always pver
622
623 call init_hb_diff( gravit, cpair, ntop_eddy, nbot_eddy, pref_mid, karman, eddy_scheme )
624
625 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------- !
626 ! Initialize turbulent mountain stress module !
627 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------!
628
629 if ( do_tms) then
630 call init_tms( r8, tms_orocnst, tms_z0fac, karman, gravit, rair, errstring)
631 call handle_errmsg(errstring, subname="init_tms")
632
633 call addfld( 'TAUTMSX' ,'N/m2 ', 1, 'A', 'Zonal turbulent mountain surface stress', phys_decomp )
634 call addfld( 'TAUTMSY' ,'N/m2 ', 1, 'A', 'Meridional turbulent mountain surface stress', phys_decomp )
635 if (history_amwg) then
636 call add_default( 'TAUTMSX ', 1, ' ' )
637 call add_default( 'TAUTMSY ', 1, ' ' )
638 end if
639 if (masterproc) then
640 write(iulog,*)'Using turbulent mountain stress module'
641 write(iulog,*)' tms_orocnst = ',tms_orocnst
642 write(iulog,*)' tms_z0fac = ',tms_z0fac
643 end if
644 endif
645
646 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------- !
647 ! Add output fields for the history files
648 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------- !
649
650 if (clubb_do_deep) then
651 call addfld ('MU_CLUBB','1/m',1,'A','CLUBB value of entrainment',phys_decomp)
652 endif
653
654 ! These are default CLUBB output. Not the higher order history budgets
655 call addfld ('RHO_CLUBB', 'kg/m3', pverp, 'A', 'Air Density', phys_decomp)
656 call addfld ('UP2_CLUBB', 'm2/s2', pverp, 'A', 'Zonal Velocity Variance', phys_decomp)
657 call addfld ('VP2_CLUBB', 'm2/s2', pverp, 'A', 'Meridional Velocity Variance', phys_decomp)
658 call addfld ('WP2_CLUBB', 'm2/s2', pverp, 'A', 'Vertical Velocity Variance', phys_decomp)
659 call addfld ('UPWP_CLUBB', 'm2/s2', pverp, 'A', 'Zonal Momentum Flux', phys_decomp)
660 call addfld ('VPWP_CLUBB', 'm2/s2', pverp, 'A', 'Meridional Momentum Flux', phys_decomp)
661 call addfld ('WP3_CLUBB', 'm3/s3', pverp, 'A', 'Third Moment Vertical Velocity', phys_decomp)
662 call addfld ('WPTHLP_CLUBB', 'W/m2', pverp, 'A', 'Heat Flux', phys_decomp)
663 call addfld ('WPRTP_CLUBB', 'W/m2', pverp, 'A', 'Moisture Flux', phys_decomp)
664 call addfld ('RTP2_CLUBB', 'g^2/kg^2', pverp, 'A', 'Moisture Variance', phys_decomp)
665 call addfld ('THLP2_CLUBB', 'K^2', pverp, 'A', 'Temperature Variance', phys_decomp)
666 call addfld ('RTPTHLP_CLUBB', 'K g/kg', pverp, 'A', 'Temp. Moist. Covariance', phys_decomp)
667 call addfld ('RCM_CLUBB', 'g/kg', pverp, 'A', 'Cloud Water Mixing Ratio', phys_decomp)
668 call addfld ('WPRCP_CLUBB', 'W/m2', pverp, 'A', 'Liquid Water Flux', phys_decomp)
669 call addfld ('CLOUDFRAC_CLUBB', 'fraction', pver, 'A', 'Cloud Fraction', phys_decomp)
670 call addfld ('RCMINLAYER_CLUBB', 'g/kg', pverp, 'A', 'Cloud Water in Layer', phys_decomp)
671 call addfld ('CLOUDCOVER_CLUBB', 'fraction', pverp, 'A', 'Cloud Cover', phys_decomp)
672 call addfld ('WPTHVP_CLUBB', 'W/m2', pver, 'A', 'Buoyancy Flux',phys_decomp)
673 call addfld ('RVMTEND_CLUBB', 'g/kg /s', pver, 'A', 'Water vapor tendency',phys_decomp)
674 call addfld ('STEND_CLUBB', 'k/s', pver, 'A', 'Temperature tendency',phys_decomp)
675 call addfld ('RCMTEND_CLUBB', 'g/kg /s', pver, 'A', 'Cloud Liquid Water Tendency',phys_decomp)
676 call addfld ('RIMTEND_CLUBB', 'g/kg /s', pver, 'A', 'Cloud Ice Tendency',phys_decomp)
677 call addfld ('UTEND_CLUBB', 'm/s /s', pver, 'A', 'U-wind Tendency',phys_decomp)
678 call addfld ('VTEND_CLUBB', 'm/s /s', pver, 'A', 'V-wind Tendency',phys_decomp)
679 call addfld ('ZT_CLUBB', 'm', pverp, 'A', 'Thermodynamic Heights',phys_decomp)
680 call addfld ('ZM_CLUBB', 'm', pverp, 'A', 'Momentum Heights',phys_decomp)
681 call addfld ('UM_CLUBB', 'm/s', pverp, 'A', 'Zonal Wind',phys_decomp)
682 call addfld ('VM_CLUBB', 'm/s', pverp, 'A', 'Meridional Wind',phys_decomp)
683 call addfld ('THETAL', 'K', pver, 'A', 'Liquid Water Potential Temperature',phys_decomp)
684 call addfld ('PBLH', 'm', 1, 'A', 'PBL height',phys_decomp)
685 call addfld ('QT', 'kg/kg', pver, 'A', 'Total water mixing ratio',phys_decomp)
686 call addfld ('SL', 'J/kg', pver, 'A', 'Liquid water static energy',phys_decomp)
687 call addfld ('CLDST', 'fraction', pver, 'A', 'Stratus cloud fraction',phys_decomp)
688 call addfld ('ZMDLF', 'kg/kg/s', pver, 'A', 'Detrained liquid water from ZM convection',phys_decomp)
689 call addfld ('TTENDICE', 'K/s ', pver, 'A', 'T tendency from Ice Saturation Adjustment',phys_decomp)
690 call addfld ('QVTENDICE', 'kg/kg/s ', pver, 'A', 'Q tendency from Ice Saturation Adjustment',phys_decomp)
691 call addfld ('QITENDICE', 'kg/kg/s ', pver, 'A', 'CLDICE tendency from Ice Saturation Adjustment',phys_decomp)
692 call addfld ('NITENDICE', 'kg/kg/s ', pver, 'A', 'NUMICE tendency from Ice Saturation Adjustment',phys_decomp)
693 call addfld ('DPDLFLIQ ', 'kg/kg/s ', pver, 'A', 'Detrained liquid water from deep convection',phys_decomp)
694 call addfld ('DPDLFICE ', 'kg/kg/s ', pver, 'A', 'Detrained ice from deep convection',phys_decomp)
695 call addfld ('DPDLFT ', 'K/s ', pver, 'A', 'T-tendency due to deep convective detrainment',phys_decomp)
696 call addfld ('RELVAR ', '- ', pver, 'A', 'Relative cloud water variance',phys_decomp)
697
698
699 call addfld ('CONCLD ', 'fraction', pver, 'A', 'Convective cloud cover',phys_decomp)
700 call addfld ('CMELIQ ', 'kg/kg/s ', pver, 'A', 'Rate of cond-evap of liq within the cloud',phys_decomp)
701
702 ! Initialize statistics, below are dummy variables
703 dum1 = 300._r8
704 dum2 = 1200._r8
705 dum3 = 300._r8
706
707 if (l_stats) then
708
709 call stats_init_clubb( .true., dum1, dum2, &
710 pverp, pverp, pverp, dum3 )
711
712 allocate(out_zt(pcols,pverp,zt%nn))
713 allocate(out_zm(pcols,pverp,zm%nn))
714 allocate(out_sfc(pcols,1,sfc%nn))
715
716 allocate(out_radzt(pcols,pverp,rad_zt%nn))
717 allocate(out_radzm(pcols,pverp,rad_zm%nn))
718
719 endif
720
721 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------- !
722 ! Make all of this output default, this is not CLUBB history
723 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------- !
724 if (clubb_do_adv .or. history_clubb) then
725 call add_default('WP2_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
726 call add_default('WP3_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
727 call add_default('WPTHLP_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
728 call add_default('WPRTP_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
729 call add_default('RTP2_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
730 call add_default('THLP2_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
731 call add_default('RTPTHLP_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
732 call add_default('UP2_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
733 call add_default('VP2_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
734 end if
735
736 if (history_clubb) then
737
738 if (clubb_do_deep) then
739 call add_default('MU_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
740 endif
741
742 call add_default('RELVAR', 1, ' ')
743 call add_default('RHO_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
744 call add_default('UPWP_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
745 call add_default('VPWP_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
746 call add_default('RCM_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
747 call add_default('WPRCP_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
748 call add_default('CLOUDFRAC_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
749 call add_default('RCMINLAYER_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
750 call add_default('CLOUDCOVER_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
751 call add_default('WPTHVP_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
752 call add_default('RVMTEND_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
753 call add_default('STEND_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
754 call add_default('RCMTEND_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
755 call add_default('RIMTEND_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
756 call add_default('UTEND_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
757 call add_default('VTEND_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
758 call add_default('ZT_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
759 call add_default('ZM_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
760 call add_default('UM_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
761 call add_default('VM_CLUBB', 1, ' ')
762 call add_default('SL', 1, ' ')
763 call add_default('QT', 1, ' ')
764 call add_default('CONCLD', 1, ' ')
765
766 end if
767
768 if (history_amwg) then
769 call add_default('PBLH', 1, ' ')
770 end if
771
772 if (history_budget) then
773 call add_default('DPDLFLIQ', history_budget_histfile_num, ' ')
774 call add_default('DPDLFICE', history_budget_histfile_num, ' ')
775 call add_default('DPDLFT', history_budget_histfile_num, ' ')
776 call add_default('STEND_CLUBB', history_budget_histfile_num, ' ')
777 call add_default('RCMTEND_CLUBB', history_budget_histfile_num, ' ')
778 call add_default('RIMTEND_CLUBB', history_budget_histfile_num, ' ')
779 call add_default('RVMTEND_CLUBB', history_budget_histfile_num, ' ')
780 call add_default('UTEND_CLUBB', history_budget_histfile_num, ' ')
781 call add_default('VTEND_CLUBB', history_budget_histfile_num, ' ')
782 endif
783
784 ! --------------- !
785 ! First step? !
786 ! Initialization !
787 ! --------------- !
788
789 ! Is this the first time step? If so then initialize CLUBB variables as follows
790 if (is_first_step()) then
791
792 call pbuf_set_field(pbuf2d, wp2_idx, w_tol_sqd)
793 call pbuf_set_field(pbuf2d, wp3_idx, 0.0_r8)
794 call pbuf_set_field(pbuf2d, wpthlp_idx, 0.0_r8)
795 call pbuf_set_field(pbuf2d, wprtp_idx, 0.0_r8)
796 call pbuf_set_field(pbuf2d, rtpthlp_idx, 0.0_r8)
797 call pbuf_set_field(pbuf2d, rtp2_idx, rt_tol**2)
798 call pbuf_set_field(pbuf2d, thlp2_idx, thl_tol**2)
799 call pbuf_set_field(pbuf2d, up2_idx, w_tol_sqd)
800 call pbuf_set_field(pbuf2d, vp2_idx, w_tol_sqd)
801
802 call pbuf_set_field(pbuf2d, upwp_idx, 0.0_r8)
803 call pbuf_set_field(pbuf2d, vpwp_idx, 0.0_r8)
804 call pbuf_set_field(pbuf2d, tke_idx, 0.0_r8)
805 call pbuf_set_field(pbuf2d, kvh_idx, 0.0_r8)
806 call pbuf_set_field(pbuf2d, fice_idx, 0.0_r8)
807 call pbuf_set_field(pbuf2d, radf_idx, 0.0_r8)
808
809 endif
810
811 ! --------------- !
812 ! End !
813 ! Initialization !
814 ! --------------- !
815
816#endif
817 end subroutine clubb_ini_cam
818
819
820 ! =============================================================================== !
821 ! !
822 ! =============================================================================== !
823
824 subroutine clubb_tend_cam( &
825 state, ptend_all, pbuf, hdtime, &
826 cmfmc, cmfmc2, cam_in, sgh30, &
827 macmic_it, cld_macmic_num_steps,dlf, det_s, det_ice)
828
829!-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
830! Description: Provide tendencies of shallow convection, turbulence, and
831! macrophysics from CLUBB to CAM
832!
833! Author: Cheryl Craig, March 2011
834! Modifications: Pete Bogenschutz, March 2011 and onward
835! Origin: Based heavily on UWM clubb_init.F90
836! References:
837! None
838!-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
839
840 use physics_types, only: physics_state, physics_ptend, &
841 physics_state_copy, physics_ptend_init, &
842 physics_ptend_sum, physics_update
843
844 use physics_buffer, only: pbuf_get_index, pbuf_old_tim_idx, pbuf_get_field, &
845 pbuf_set_field, physics_buffer_desc
846
847 use ppgrid, only: pver, pverp, pcols
848 use constituents, only: cnst_get_ind
849 use camsrfexch, only: cam_in_t
850 use ref_pres, only: top_lev => trop_cloud_top_lev
851 use time_manager, only: is_first_step
852 use cam_abortutils, only: endrun
853 use wv_saturation, only: qsat
854 use micro_mg_cam, only: micro_mg_version
855
856#ifdef CLUBB_SGS
857 use hb_diff, only: pblintd
858 use scamMOD, only: single_column,scm_clubb_iop_name
859 use phys_grid, only: get_lat_p
860 use parameter_indices, only: nparams
861 use parameters_tunable, only: read_parameters, setup_parameters ! Subroutine
862 use cldfrc2m, only: aist_vector
863 use clubb_precision,only: time_precision
864 use cam_history, only: outfld
865 use clubb_core, only: advance_clubb_core, calculate_thlp2_rad
866 use grid_class, only: zt2zm, zm2zt, gr, setup_grid, cleanup_grid
867 use constants_clubb,only: w_tol_sqd, rt_tol, thl_tol
868 use model_flags, only: l_use_boussinesq
869 use stats_variables,only: l_stats, stats_tsamp, stats_tout, zt, &
870 sfc, zm, rad_zt, rad_zm, l_output_rad_files
871 use pdf_parameter_module, only: pdf_parameter ! Type
872 use parameters_tunable, only: mu
873 use saturation, only: sat_mixrat_liq
874 use trb_mtn_stress, only: compute_tms
875 use stats_subs, only: stats_begin_timestep
876 use advance_xp2_xpyp_module, only: update_xp2_mc_tndcy
877 use macrop_driver, only: ice_macro_tend
878
879#endif
880
881 implicit none
882
883 ! --------------- !
884 ! Input Auguments !
885 ! --------------- !
886
887 type(physics_state), intent(in) :: state ! Physics state variables [vary]
888 type(cam_in_t), intent(in) :: cam_in
889 real(r8), intent(in) :: hdtime ! Host model timestep [s]
890 real(r8), intent(in) :: dlf(pcols,pver) ! Detraining cld H20 from deep convection [kg/ks/s]
891 real(r8), intent(in) :: cmfmc(pcols,pverp) ! convective mass flux--m sub c [kg/m2/s]
892 real(r8), intent(in) :: cmfmc2(pcols,pverp) ! shallow convective mass flux--m subc [kg/m2/s]
893 real(r8), intent(in) :: sgh30(pcols) ! std deviation of orography [m]
894 integer, intent(in) :: cld_macmic_num_steps ! number of mac-mic iterations
895 integer, intent(in) :: macmic_it ! number of mac-mic iterations
896
897 ! ---------------------- !
898 ! Input-Output Auguments !
899 ! ---------------------- !
900
901 type(physics_buffer_desc), pointer :: pbuf(:)
902
903 ! ---------------------- !
904 ! Output Auguments !
905 ! ---------------------- !
906
907 type(physics_ptend), intent(out) :: ptend_all ! package tendencies
908
909 ! These two variables are needed for energy check
910 real(r8), intent(out) :: det_s(pcols) ! Integral of detrained static energy from ice
911 real(r8), intent(out) :: det_ice(pcols) ! Integral of detrained ice for energy check
912
913
914 ! --------------- !
915 ! Local Variables !
916 ! --------------- !
917
918#ifdef CLUBB_SGS
919
920 type(physics_state) :: state1 ! Local copy of state variable
921 type(physics_ptend) :: ptend_loc ! Local tendency from processes, added up to return as ptend_all
922
923 integer :: i, j, k, t, ixind, nadv
924 integer :: ixcldice, ixcldliq, ixnumliq, ixnumice, ixq
925 integer :: itim_old
926 integer :: ncol, lchnk ! # of columns, and chunk identifier
927 integer :: err_code ! Diagnostic, for if some calculation goes amiss.
928 integer :: begin_height, end_height
929 integer :: icnt
930
931 real(r8) :: frac_limit, ic_limit
932
933 real(r8) :: dtime ! CLUBB time step [s]
934 real(r8) :: clubb_dtimemax ! max CLUBB time step
935 real(r8) :: edsclr_in(pverp,edsclr_dim) ! Scalars to be diffused through CLUBB [units vary]
936 real(r8) :: wp2_in(pverp) ! vertical velocity variance (CLUBB) [m^2/s^2]
937 real(r8) :: wp3_in(pverp) ! third moment vertical velocity [m^3/s^3]
938 real(r8) :: wpthlp_in(pverp) ! turbulent flux of thetal [K m/s]
939 real(r8) :: wprtp_in(pverp) ! turbulent flux of total water [kg/kg m/s]
940 real(r8) :: rtpthlp_in(pverp) ! covariance of thetal and qt [kg/kg K]
941 real(r8) :: rtp2_in(pverp) ! total water variance [kg^2/k^2]
942 real(r8) :: thlp2_in(pverp) ! thetal variance [K^2]
943 real(r8) :: up2_in(pverp) ! meridional wind variance [m^2/s^2]
944 real(r8) :: vp2_in(pverp) ! zonal wind variance [m^2/s^2]
945 real(r8) :: upwp_in(pverp) ! meridional wind flux [m^2/s^2]
946 real(r8) :: vpwp_in(pverp) ! zonal wind flux [m^2/s^2]
947 real(r8) :: thlm_in(pverp) ! liquid water potential temperature (thetal) [K]
948 real(r8) :: rtm_in(pverp) ! total water mixing ratio [kg/kg]
949 real(r8) :: rvm_in(pverp) ! water vapor mixing ratio [kg/kg]
950 real(r8) :: um_in(pverp) ! meridional wind [m/s]
951 real(r8) :: vm_in(pverp) ! zonal wind [m/s]
952 real(r8) :: rho_in(pverp) ! mid-point density [kg/m^3]
953 real(r8) :: pre_in(pverp) ! input for precip evaporation
954 real(r8) :: rtp2_mc_out(pverp) ! total water tendency from rain evap
955 real(r8) :: thlp2_mc_out(pverp) ! thetal tendency from rain evap
956 real(r8) :: wprtp_mc_out(pverp)
957 real(r8) :: wpthlp_mc_out(pverp)
958 real(r8) :: rtpthlp_mc_out(pverp)
959 real(r8) :: rcm_out(pverp) ! CLUBB output of liquid water mixing ratio [kg/kg]
960 real(r8) :: rcm_out_zm(pverp)
961 real(r8) :: wprcp_out(pverp) ! CLUBB output of flux of liquid water [kg/kg m/s]
962 real(r8) :: cloud_frac_out(pverp) ! CLUBB output of cloud fraction [fraction]
963 real(r8) :: rcm_in_layer_out(pverp) ! CLUBB output of in-cloud liq. wat. mix. ratio [kg/kg]
964 real(r8) :: cloud_cover_out(pverp) ! CLUBB output of in-cloud cloud fraction [fraction]
965 real(r8) :: thlprcp_out(pverp)
966 real(r8) :: rho_ds_zm(pverp) ! Dry, static density on momentum levels [kg/m^3]
967 real(r8) :: rho_ds_zt(pverp) ! Dry, static density on thermodynamic levels [kg/m^3]
968 real(r8) :: invrs_rho_ds_zm(pverp) ! Inv. dry, static density on momentum levels [m^3/kg]
969 real(r8) :: invrs_rho_ds_zt(pverp) ! Inv. dry, static density on thermo. levels [m^3/kg]
970 real(r8) :: thv_ds_zm(pverp) ! Dry, base-state theta_v on momentum levels [K]
971 real(r8) :: thv_ds_zt(pverp) ! Dry, base-state theta_v on thermo. levels [K]
972 real(r8) :: rfrzm(pverp)
973 real(r8) :: radf(pverp)
974 real(r8) :: wprtp_forcing(pverp)

1161 frac_limit = 0.01_r8

1166 else

1171

1177

1179

1182 endif
1183
1184 call physics_state_copy(state,state1)
1185
1186 if (micro_do_icesupersat) then
1187 naai_idx = pbuf_get_index('NAAI')

1189 call physics_ptend_init(ptend_all, state%psetcols, 'clubb')
1190 endif

1193
