1196
1197 ! Determine time step of physics buffer
1198
1199 itim_old = pbuf_old_tim_idx()
1200
1201 ! Establish associations between pointers and physics buffer fields
1202
1203 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, wp2_idx, wp2, start=(/1,1,itim_old/), kount=(/pcols,pverp,1/))
1204 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, wp3_idx, wp3, start=(/1,1,itim_old/), kount=(/pcols,pverp,1/))
1205 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, wpthlp_idx, wpthlp, start=(/1,1,itim_old/), kount=(/pcols,pverp,1/))
1206 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, wprtp_idx, wprtp, start=(/1,1,itim_old/), kount=(/pcols,pverp,1/))
1207 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, rtpthlp_idx, rtpthlp, start=(/1,1,itim_old/), kount=(/pcols,pverp,1/))
1208 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, rtp2_idx, rtp2, start=(/1,1,itim_old/), kount=(/pcols,pverp,1/))
1209 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, thlp2_idx, thlp2, start=(/1,1,itim_old/), kount=(/pcols,pverp,1/))
1210 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, up2_idx, up2, start=(/1,1,itim_old/), kount=(/pcols,pverp,1/))
1211 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, vp2_idx, vp2, start=(/1,1,itim_old/), kount=(/pcols,pverp,1/))
1212
1213 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, upwp_idx, upwp, start=(/1,1,itim_old/), kount=(/pcols,pverp,1/))
1214 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, vpwp_idx, vpwp, start=(/1,1,itim_old/), kount=(/pcols,pverp,1/))
1215 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, thlm_idx, thlm, start=(/1,1,itim_old/), kount=(/pcols,pverp,1/))
1216 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, rtm_idx, rtm, start=(/1,1,itim_old/), kount=(/pcols,pverp,1/))
1217 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, um_idx, um, start=(/1,1,itim_old/), kount=(/pcols,pverp,1/))
1218 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, vm_idx, vm, start=(/1,1,itim_old/), kount=(/pcols,pverp,1/))
1219
1220 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, tke_idx, tke)
1221 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, qrl_idx, qrl)
1222 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, radf_idx, radf_clubb)
1223
1224 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, cld_idx, cld, start=(/1,1,itim_old/), kount=(/pcols,pver,1/))
1225 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, concld_idx, concld, start=(/1,1,itim_old/), kount=(/pcols,pver,1/))
1226 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, ast_idx, ast, start=(/1,1,itim_old/), kount=(/pcols,pver,1/))
1227 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, alst_idx, alst, start=(/1,1,itim_old/), kount=(/pcols,pver,1/))
1228 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, aist_idx, aist, start=(/1,1,itim_old/), kount=(/pcols,pver,1/))
1229 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, qlst_idx, qlst, start=(/1,1,itim_old/), kount=(/pcols,pver,1/))
1230 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, qist_idx, qist, start=(/1,1,itim_old/), kount=(/pcols,pver,1/))
1231
1232 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, prer_evap_idx, prer_evap)
1233 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, accre_enhan_idx, accre_enhan)
1234 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, cmeliq_idx, cmeliq)
1235 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, relvar_idx, relvar)
1236 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, dp_frac_idx, deepcu)
1237 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, sh_frac_idx, shalcu)
1238 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, kvm_idx, khzt)
1239 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, kvh_idx, khzm)
1240 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, pblh_idx, pblh)
1241 call pbuf_get_field(pbuf, icwmrdp_idx, dp_icwmr)
1242
1243 ! Intialize the apply_const variable (note special logic is due to eularian backstepping)
1244 if (clubb_do_adv .and. (is_first_step() .or. all(wpthlp(1:ncol,1:pver) .eq. 0._r8))) then
1245 apply_const = 0._r8 ! On first time through do not remove constant
1246 ! from moments since it has not been added yet
1247 endif
1248
1249 if (micro_do_icesupersat) then
1250
1251 ! -------------------------------------- !
1252 ! Ice Saturation Adjustment Computation !
1253 ! -------------------------------------- !
1254
1255 lq2(:) = .FALSE.
1256 lq2(1) = .TRUE.
1257 lq2(ixcldice) = .TRUE.
1258 lq2(ixnumice) = .TRUE.
1259
1260 latsub = latvap + latice
1261
1262 call physics_ptend_init(ptend_loc, state%psetcols, 'iceadj', ls=.true., lq=lq2 )
1263
1264 stend(:ncol,:)=0._r8
1265 qvtend(:ncol,:)=0._r8
1266 qitend(:ncol,:)=0._r8
1267 initend(:ncol,:)=0._r8
1268
1269 call ice_macro_tend(naai(:ncol,top_lev:pver),state1%t(:ncol,top_lev:pver), &
1270 state1%pmid(:ncol,top_lev:pver),state1%q(:ncol,top_lev:pver,1),state1%q(:ncol,top_lev:pver,ixcldice),&
1271 state1%q(:ncol,top_lev:pver,ixnumice),latsub,hdtime,&
1272 stend(:ncol,top_lev:pver),qvtend(:ncol,top_lev:pver),qitend(:ncol,top_lev:pver),&
1273 initend(:ncol,top_lev:pver))
1274
1275 ! update local copy of state with the tendencies
1276 ptend_loc%q(:ncol,top_lev:pver,1)=qvtend(:ncol,top_lev:pver)
1277 ptend_loc%q(:ncol,top_lev:pver,ixcldice)=qitend(:ncol,top_lev:pver)
1278 ptend_loc%q(:ncol,top_lev:pver,ixnumice)=initend(:ncol,top_lev:pver)
1279 ptend_loc%s(:ncol,top_lev:pver)=stend(:ncol,top_lev:pver)
1280
1281 ! Add the ice tendency to the output tendency
1282 call physics_ptend_sum(ptend_loc, ptend_all, ncol)
1283
1284 ! ptend_loc is reset to zero by this call
1285 call physics_update(state1, ptend_loc, hdtime)
1286
1287 !Write output for tendencies:
1288 ! oufld: QVTENDICE,QITENDICE,NITENDICE
1289 call outfld( 'TTENDICE', stend/cpair, pcols, lchnk )
1290 call outfld( 'QVTENDICE', qvtend, pcols, lchnk )
1291 call outfld( 'QITENDICE', qitend, pcols, lchnk )
1292 call outfld( 'NITENDICE', initend, pcols, lchnk )
1293
1294 endif
1295
1296 ! Determine CLUBB time step and make it sub-step friendly
1297 ! For now we want CLUBB time step to be 5 min since that is
1298 ! what has been scientifically validated. However, there are certain
1299 ! instances when a 5 min time step will not be possible (based on
1300 ! host model time step or on macro-micro sub-stepping
1301
1302 clubb_dtimemax = 300._r8 ! Default CLUBB time step
1303 dtime = clubb_dtimemax
1304
1305 ! Now check to see if dtime is greater than the host model
1306 ! (or sub stepped) time step. If it is, then simply
1307 ! set it equal to the host (or sub step) time step.
1308 ! This section is mostly to deal with small host model
1309 ! time steps (or small sub-steps)
1310
1311 if (dtime .gt. hdtime) then
1312 dtime = hdtime
1313 endif
1314
1315 ! Now check to see if CLUBB time step divides evenly into
1316 ! the host model time step. If not, force it to divide evenly.
1317 ! We also want it to be 5 minutes or less. This section is
1318 ! mainly for host model time steps that are not evenly divisible
1319 ! by 5 minutes
1320
1321 if (mod(hdtime,dtime) .ne. 0) then
1322 dtime = hdtime/2._r8
1323 do while (dtime .gt. 300._r8)
1324 dtime = dtime/2._r8
1325 end do
1326 endif
1327
1328 ! If resulting host model time step and CLUBB time step do not divide evenly
1329 ! into each other, have model throw a fit.
1330
1331 if (mod(hdtime,dtime) .ne. 0) then
1332 call endrun('clubb_tend_cam: CLUBB time step and HOST time step NOT compatible')
1333 endif
1334
1335 ! determine number of timesteps CLUBB core should be advanced,
1336 ! host time step divided by CLUBB time step
1337 nadv = max(hdtime/dtime,1._r8)
1338
1339 ! Initialize forcings for transported scalars to zero
1340
1341 sclrm_forcing(:,:) = 0._r8
1342 edsclrm_forcing(:,:) = 0._r8
1343 sclrm(:,:) = 0._r8
1344
1345 minqn = 0._r8
1346 newfice(:,:) = 0._r8
1347 where(state1%q(:ncol,:pver,3) .gt. minqn) &
1348 newfice(:ncol,:pver) = state1%q(:ncol,:pver,3)/(state1%q(:ncol,:pver,2)+state1%q(:ncol,:pver,3))
1349
1350 ! Compute exner function consistent with CLUBB's definition, which uses a constant
1351 ! surface pressure. CAM's exner (in state does not). Therefore, for consistent
1352 ! treatment with CLUBB code, anytime exner is needed to treat CLUBB variables
1353 ! (such as thlm), use "exner_clubb" other wise use the exner in state
1354
1355 do k=1,pver
1356 do i=1,ncol
1357 exner_clubb(i,k) = 1._r8/((state1%pmid(i,k)/p0_clubb)**(rair/cpair))
1358 enddo
1359 enddo
1360
1361 ! At each CLUBB call, initialize mean momentum and thermo CLUBB state
1362 ! from the CAM state
1363
1364 do k=1,pver ! loop over levels
1365 do i=1,ncol ! loop over columns
1366
1367 rtm(i,k) = state1%q(i,k,ixq)+state1%q(i,k,ixcldliq)
1368 rvm(i,k) = state1%q(i,k,ixq)
1369 um(i,k) = state1%u(i,k)
1370 vm(i,k) = state1%v(i,k)
1371 thlm(i,k) = state1%t(i,k)*exner_clubb(i,k)-(latvap/cpair)*state1%q(i,k,ixcldliq)
1372
1373 if (clubb_do_adv) then
1374 if (macmic_it .eq. 1) then
1375
1376 ! Note that some of the moments below can be positive or negative.
1377 ! Remove a constant that was added to prevent dynamics from clipping
1378 ! them to prevent dynamics from making them positive.
1379 thlp2(i,k) = state1%q(i,k,ixthlp2)
1380 rtp2(i,k) = state1%q(i,k,ixrtp2)
1381 rtpthlp(i,k) = state1%q(i,k,ixrtpthlp) - (rtpthlp_const*apply_const)
1382 wpthlp(i,k) = state1%q(i,k,ixwpthlp) - (wpthlp_const*apply_const)
1383 wprtp(i,k) = state1%q(i,k,ixwprtp) - (wprtp_const*apply_const)
1384 wp2(i,k) = state1%q(i,k,ixwp2)
1385 wp3(i,k) = state1%q(i,k,ixwp3) - (wp3_const*apply_const)
1386 up2(i,k) = state1%q(i,k,ixup2)
1387 vp2(i,k) = state1%q(i,k,ixvp2)
1388 endif
1389 endif
1390
1391 enddo
1392 enddo
1393
1394 if (clubb_do_adv) then
1395 ! If not last step of macmic loop then set apply_const back to
1396 ! zero to prevent output from being corrupted.
1397 if (macmic_it .eq. cld_macmic_num_steps) then
1398 apply_const = 1._r8
1399 else
1400 apply_const = 0._r8
1401 endif
1402 endif
1403
1404 rtm(1:ncol,pverp) = rtm(1:ncol,pver)
1405 um(1:ncol,pverp) = state1%u(1:ncol,pver)
1406 vm(1:ncol,pverp) = state1%v(1:ncol,pver)
1407 thlm(1:ncol,pverp) = thlm(1:ncol,pver)
1408
1409 if (clubb_do_adv) then
1410 thlp2(1:ncol,pverp)=thlp2(1:ncol,pver)
1411 rtp2(1:ncol,pverp)=rtp2(1:ncol,pver)
1412 rtpthlp(1:ncol,pverp)=rtpthlp(1:ncol,pver)
1413 wpthlp(1:ncol,pverp)=wpthlp(1:ncol,pver)
1414 wprtp(1:ncol,pverp)=wprtp(1:ncol,pver)
1415 wp2(1:ncol,pverp)=wp2(1:ncol,pver)
1416 wp3(1:ncol,pverp)=wp3(1:ncol,pver)
1417 up2(1:ncol,pverp)=up2(1:ncol,pver)
1418 vp2(1:ncol,pverp)=vp2(1:ncol,pver)
1419 endif
1420
1421 ! Compute integrals of static energy, kinetic energy, water vapor, and liquid water
1422 ! for the computation of total energy before CLUBB is called. This is for an
1423 ! effort to conserve energy since liquid water potential temperature (which CLUBB
1424 ! conserves) and static energy (which CAM conserves) are not exactly equal.
1425 se_b = 0._r8
1426 ke_b = 0._r8
1427 wv_b = 0._r8
1428 wl_b = 0._r8
1429 do k=1,pver
1430 do i=1,ncol
1431 se_b(i) = se_b(i) + state1%s(i,k)*state1%pdel(i,k)/gravit
1432 ke_b(i) = ke_b(i) + 0.5_r8*(um(i,k)**2+vm(i,k)**2)*state1%pdel(i,k)/gravit
1433 wv_b(i) = wv_b(i) + state1%q(i,k,ixq)*state1%pdel(i,k)/gravit
1434 wl_b(i) = wl_b(i) + state1%q(i,k,ixcldliq)*state1%pdel(i,k)/gravit
1435 enddo
1436 enddo
1437
1438 ! Compute virtual potential temperature, which is needed for CLUBB
1439 do k=1,pver
1440 do i=1,ncol
1441 thv(i,k) = state1%t(i,k)*exner_clubb(i,k)*(1._r8+zvir*state1%q(i,k,ixq)&
1442 -state1%q(i,k,ixcldliq))
1443 enddo
1444 enddo
1445
1446 ! ------------------------------------------------- !
1447 ! Begin module to compute turbulent mountain stress !
1448 ! ------------------------------------------------- !
1449
1450 call compute_tms( pcols, pver, ncol, &
1451 state1%u, state1%v, state1%t, state1%pmid, &
1452 state1%exner, state1%zm, sgh30, ksrftms, &
1453 tautmsx, tautmsy, cam_in%landfrac )
1454
1455 if (micro_do_icesupersat) then
1456 call physics_ptend_init(ptend_loc,state%psetcols, 'clubb', ls=.true., lu=.true., lv=.true., lq=lq)
1457 endif
1458
1459 ! ------------------------------------------------- !
1460 ! End module to compute turbulent mountain stress !
1461 ! ------------------------------------------------- !
1462
1463 ! Loop over all columns in lchnk to advance CLUBB core
1464 do i=1,ncol ! loop over columns
1465
1466 ! Set time_elapsed to host model time step, this is for
1467 ! CLUBB's budget stats
1468 time_elapsed = hdtime
1469
1470 ! Determine Coriolis force at given latitude. This is never used
1471 ! when CLUBB is implemented in a host model, therefore just set
1472 ! to zero.
1473 fcor = 0._r8
1474
1475 ! Define the CLUBB momentum grid (in height, units of m)
1476 do k=1,pverp
1477 zi_g(k) = state1%zi(i,pverp-k+1)-state1%zi(i,pver+1)
1478 enddo
1479
1480 ! Define the CLUBB thermodynamic grid (in units of m)
1481 do k=1,pver
1482 zt_g(k+1) = state1%zm(i,pver-k+1)-state1%zi(i,pver+1)
1483 dz_g(k) = state1%zi(i,k)-state1%zi(i,k+1) ! compute thickness
1484 enddo
1485
1486 ! Thermodynamic ghost point is below surface
1487 zt_g(1) = -1._r8*zt_g(2)
1488
1489 ! Set the elevation of the surface
1490 sfc_elevation = state1%zi(i,pver+1)
1491
1492 ! Compute thermodynamic stuff needed for CLUBB on thermo levels.
1493 ! Inputs for the momentum levels are set below setup_clubb core
1494 do k=1,pver
1495 p_in_Pa(k+1) = state1%pmid(i,pver-k+1) ! Pressure profile
1496 exner(k+1) = 1._r8/exner_clubb(i,pver-k+1)
1497 rho_ds_zt(k+1) = (1._r8/gravit)*(state1%pdel(i,pver-k+1)/dz_g(pver-k+1))
1498 invrs_rho_ds_zt(k+1) = 1._r8/(rho_ds_zt(k+1)) ! Inverse ds rho at thermo
1499 rho(i,k+1) = rho_ds_zt(k+1) ! rho on thermo
1500 thv_ds_zt(k+1) = thv(i,pver-k+1) ! thetav on thermo
1501 rfrzm(k+1) = state1%q(i,pver-k+1,ixcldice)
1502 radf(k+1) = radf_clubb(i,pver-k+1)
1503 qrl_clubb(k+1) = qrl(i,pver-k+1)/(cpair*state1%pdel(i,pver-k+1))
1504 enddo
1505
1506 ! Below computes the same stuff for the ghost point. May or may
1507 ! not be needed, just to be safe to avoid NaN's
1508 rho_ds_zt(1) = rho_ds_zt(2)
1509 invrs_rho_ds_zt(1) = invrs_rho_ds_zt(2)
1510 rho(i,1) = rho_ds_zt(2)
1511 thv_ds_zt(1) = thv_ds_zt(2)
1512 rho_zt(:) = rho(i,:)
1513 p_in_Pa(1) = p_in_Pa(2)
1514 exner(1) = exner(2)
1515 rfrzm(1) = rfrzm(2)
1516 radf(1) = radf(2)
1517 qrl_clubb(1) = qrl_clubb(2)
1518
1519 ! Compute mean w wind on thermo grid, convert from omega to w
1520 wm_zt(1) = 0._r8
1521 do k=1,pver
1522 wm_zt(k+1) = -1._r8*state1%omega(i,pver-k+1)/(rho(i,k+1)*gravit)
1523 enddo
1524
1525 ! Surface fluxes provided by host model
1526 wpthlp_sfc = cam_in%shf(i)/(cpair*rho(i,1)) ! Sensible heat flux
1527 wprtp_sfc = cam_in%lhf(i)/(latvap*rho(i,1)) ! Latent heat flux
1528 upwp_sfc = cam_in%wsx(i)/rho(i,1) ! Surface meridional momentum flux
1529 vpwp_sfc = cam_in%wsy(i)/rho(i,1) ! Surface zonal momentum flux
1530
1531 ! ------------------------------------------------- !
1532 ! Begin case specific code for SCAM cases. !
1533 ! This section of code block NOT called in !
1534 ! global simulations !
1535 ! ------------------------------------------------- !
1536
1537 if (single_column) then
1538
1539 ! Initialize zo if variable ustar is used
1540
1541 if (cam_in%landfrac(i) .ge. 0.5_r8) then
1542 zo = 0.035_r8
1543 else
1544 zo = 0.0001_r8
1545 endif
1546
1547 ! Compute surface wind (ubar)
1548 ubar = sqrt(um(i,pver)**2+vm(i,pver)**2)
1549 if (ubar .lt. 0.25_r8) ubar = 0.25_r8
1550
1551 ! Below denotes case specifics for surface momentum
1552 ! and thermodynamic fluxes, depending on the case
1553
1554 ! Define ustar (based on case, if not variable)
1555 ustar = 0.25_r8 ! Initialize ustar in case no case
1556
1557 if(trim(scm_clubb_iop_name) .eq. 'BOMEX_5day') then
1558 ustar = 0.28_r8
1559 endif
1560
1561 if(trim(scm_clubb_iop_name) .eq. 'ATEX_48hr') then
1562 ustar = 0.30_r8
1563 endif
1564
1565 if(trim(scm_clubb_iop_name) .eq. 'RICO_3day') then
1566 ustar = 0.28_r8
1567 endif
1568
1569 if(trim(scm_clubb_iop_name) .eq. 'arm97' .or. trim(scm_clubb_iop_name) .eq. 'gate' .or. &
1570 trim(scm_clubb_iop_name) .eq. 'toga' .or. trim(scm_clubb_iop_name) .eq. 'mpace' .or. &
1571 trim(scm_clubb_iop_name) .eq. 'ARM_CC') then
1572
1573 bflx22 = (gravit/theta0)*wpthlp_sfc
1574 ustar = diag_ustar(zt_g(2),bflx22,ubar,zo)
1575 endif
1576
1577 ! Compute the surface momentum fluxes, if this is a SCAM simulation
1578 upwp_sfc = -um(i,pver)*ustar**2/ubar
1579 vpwp_sfc = -vm(i,pver)*ustar**2/ubar
1580
1581 endif
1582
1583 ! ------------------------------------------------- !
1584 ! Apply TMS !
1585 ! ------------------------------------------------- !
1586
1587 upwp_sfc = upwp_sfc-((ksrftms(i)*state1%u(i,pver))/rho(i,1))
1588 vpwp_sfc = vpwp_sfc-((ksrftms(i)*state1%v(i,pver))/rho(i,1))
1589
1590 ! Define surface sources for transported variables for diffusion, will
1591 ! be zero as these tendencies are done in clubb_surface
1592 do ixind=1,edsclr_dim
1593 wpedsclrp_sfc(ixind) = 0._r8
1594 enddo
1595
1596 ! Define forcings from CAM to CLUBB as zero for momentum and thermo,
1597 ! forcings already applied through CAM
1598 thlm_forcing(1:pverp) = 0._r8
1599 rtm_forcing(1:pverp) = 0._r8
1600 um_forcing(1:pverp) = 0._r8
1601 vm_forcing(1:pverp) = 0._r8
1602
1603 wprtp_forcing(1:pverp) = 0._r8
1604 wpthlp_forcing(1:pverp) = 0._r8
1605 rtp2_forcing(1:pverp) = 0._r8
1606 thlp2_forcing(1:pverp) = 0._r8
1607 rtpthlp_forcing(1:pverp) = 0._r8
1608
1609 ice_supersat_frac(1:pverp) = 0._r8
1610
1611 ! Set stats output and increment equal to CLUBB and host dt
1612 stats_tsamp = dtime
1613 stats_tout = hdtime
1614
1615 ! Heights need to be set at each timestep. Therefore, recall
1616 ! setup_grid and setup_parameters for this.
1617
1618 ! Read in parameters for CLUBB. Just read in default values
1619 call read_parameters( -99, "", clubb_params )
1620
1621 ! Set-up CLUBB core at each CLUBB call because heights can change
1622 call setup_grid(pverp, sfc_elevation, l_implemented, grid_type, &
1623 zi_g(2), zi_g(1), zi_g(pverp), zi_g(1:pverp), zt_g(1:pverp), &
1624 begin_height, end_height)
1625
1626 call setup_parameters(zi_g(2), clubb_params, pverp, grid_type, &
1627 zi_g(begin_height:end_height), zt_g(begin_height:end_height), err_code)
1628
1629 ! Compute some inputs from the thermodynamic grid
1630 ! to the momentum grid
1631 rho_ds_zm = zt2zm(rho_ds_zt)
1632 rho_zm = zt2zm(rho_zt)
1633 invrs_rho_ds_zm = zt2zm(invrs_rho_ds_zt)
1634 thv_ds_zm = zt2zm(thv_ds_zt)
1635 wm_zm = zt2zm(wm_zt)
1636
1637 ! Need to flip arrays around for CLUBB core
1638 do k=1,pverp
1639 um_in(k) = um(i,pverp-k+1)
1640 vm_in(k) = vm(i,pverp-k+1)
1641 upwp_in(k) = upwp(i,pverp-k+1)
1642 vpwp_in(k) = vpwp(i,pverp-k+1)
1643 up2_in(k) = up2(i,pverp-k+1)
1644 vp2_in(k) = vp2(i,pverp-k+1)
1645 wp2_in(k) = wp2(i,pverp-k+1)
1646 wp3_in(k) = wp3(i,pverp-k+1)
1647 rtp2_in(k) = rtp2(i,pverp-k+1)
1648 thlp2_in(k) = thlp2(i,pverp-k+1)
1649 thlm_in(k) = thlm(i,pverp-k+1)
1650 rtm_in(k) = rtm(i,pverp-k+1)
1651 rvm_in(k) = rvm(i,pverp-k+1)
1652 wprtp_in(k) = wprtp(i,pverp-k+1)
1653 wpthlp_in(k) = wpthlp(i,pverp-k+1)
1654 rtpthlp_in(k) = rtpthlp(i,pverp-k+1)
1655
1656 if (k .ne. 1) then
1657 pre_in(k) = prer_evap(i,pverp-k+1)
1658 endif
1659
1660 ! Initialize these to prevent crashing behavior
1661 rcm_out(k) = 0._r8
1662 wprcp_out(k) = 0._r8
1663 cloud_frac_out(k) = 0._r8
1664 rcm_in_layer_out(k) = 0._r8
1665 cloud_cover_out(k) = 0._r8
1666 edsclr_in(k,:) = 0._r8
1667 edsclr_out(k,:) = 0._r8
1668 khzm_out(k) = 0._r8
1669 khzt_out(k) = 0._r8
1670
1671 ! higher order scalar stuff, put to zero
1672 sclrm(k,:) = 0._r8
1673 wpsclrp(k,:) = 0._r8
1674 sclrp2(k,:) = 0._r8
1675 sclrprtp(k,:) = 0._r8
1676 sclrpthlp(k,:) = 0._r8
1677 wpsclrp_sfc(:) = 0._r8
1678
1679 enddo
1680
1681 pre_in(1) = pre_in(2)
1682
1683 if (clubb_do_adv) then
1684 if (macmic_it .eq. 1) then
1685 wp2_in=zt2zm(wp2_in)
1686 wpthlp_in=zt2zm(wpthlp_in)
1687 wprtp_in=zt2zm(wprtp_in)
1688 up2_in=zt2zm(up2_in)
1689 vp2_in=zt2zm(vp2_in)
1690 thlp2_in=zt2zm(thlp2_in)
1691 rtp2_in=zt2zm(rtp2_in)
1692 rtpthlp_in=zt2zm(rtpthlp_in)
1693
1694 do k=1,pverp
1695 thlp2_in(k)=max(thl_tol**2,thlp2_in(k))
1696 rtp2_in(k)=max(rt_tol**2,rtp2_in(k))
1697 wp2_in(k)=max(w_tol_sqd,wp2_in(k))
1698 up2_in(k)=max(w_tol_sqd,up2_in(k))
1699 vp2_in(k)=max(w_tol_sqd,vp2_in(k))
1700 enddo
1701 endif
1702 endif
1703
1704 ! Do the same for tracers
1705 icnt=0
1706 do ixind=1,pcnst
1707 if (lq(ixind)) then
1708 icnt=icnt+1
1709 do k=1,pver
1710 edsclr_in(k+1,icnt) = state1%q(i,pver-k+1,ixind)
1711 enddo
1712 edsclr_in(1,icnt) = edsclr_in(2,icnt)
1713 end if
1714 enddo
1715
1716 if (do_expldiff) then
1717 do k=1,pver
1718 edsclr_in(k+1,icnt+1) = thlm(i,pver-k+1)
1719 edsclr_in(k+1,icnt+2) = rtm(i,pver-k+1)
1720 enddo
1721
1722 edsclr_in(1,icnt+1) = edsclr_in(2,icnt+1)
1723 edsclr_in(1,icnt+2) = edsclr_in(2,icnt+2)
1724 endif
1725
1726 rho_in(:) = rho(i,:)
1727
1728 ! --------------------------------------------------------- !
1729 ! Compute cloud-top radiative cooling contribution to CLUBB !
1730 ! --------------------------------------------------------- !
1731
1732 ! Sandbox version of code to take into account meso organization
1733
1734 if (clubb_do_deep) then
1735 orgparam = 0._r8
1736 delpavg = 0._r8
1737
1738 do k = 1, pver
1739 if (abs(prer_evap(i,k)) .gt. 0._r8) then
1740 orgparam = orgparam + (abs(prer_evap(i,k)) * 1000._r8 * 1000._r8 * 2._r8 ) * state1%pdel(i,k)
1741 delpavg = delpavg + state1%pdel(i,k)
1742 endif
1743 enddo
1744
1745 if (delpavg .gt. 0._r8) then
1746 orgparam = orgparam/delpavg
1747 endif
1748
1749 ! Now compute new entrainment rate based on organization
1750 varmu2 = mu / (1._r8 + orgparam * 100._r8)
1751 varmu(i) = varmu2
1752
1753 endif
1754
1755 ! --------------------------------------------------------- !
1756 ! End cloud-top radiative cooling contribution to CLUBB !
1757 ! --------------------------------------------------------- !
1758
1759 do t=1,nadv ! do needed number of "sub" timesteps for each CAM step
1760
1761 ! Increment the statistics then being stats timestep
1762 if (l_stats) then
1763 time_elapsed = time_elapsed+dtime
1764 call stats_begin_timestep(time_elapsed)
1765 endif
1766
1767 ! Advance CLUBB CORE one timestep in the future
1768 call advance_clubb_core &
1769 ( l_implemented, dtime, fcor, sfc_elevation, &
1770 thlm_forcing, rtm_forcing, um_forcing, vm_forcing, &
1771 sclrm_forcing, edsclrm_forcing, wprtp_forcing, &
1772 wpthlp_forcing, rtp2_forcing, thlp2_forcing, &
1773 rtpthlp_forcing, wm_zm, wm_zt, &
1774 wpthlp_sfc, wprtp_sfc, upwp_sfc, vpwp_sfc, &
1775 wpsclrp_sfc, wpedsclrp_sfc, &
1776 p_in_Pa, rho_zm, rho_in, exner, &
1777 rho_ds_zm, rho_ds_zt, invrs_rho_ds_zm, &
1778 invrs_rho_ds_zt, thv_ds_zm, thv_ds_zt, &
1779 rfrzm, radf, do_expldiff, &
1780#ifdef CLUBBND_CAM
1781 varmu2, &
1782#endif
1783 um_in, vm_in, upwp_in, &
1784 vpwp_in, up2_in, vp2_in, &
1785 thlm_in, rtm_in, wprtp_in, wpthlp_in, &
1786 wp2_in, wp3_in, rtp2_in, &
1787 thlp2_in, rtpthlp_in, &
1788 sclrm, sclrp2, sclrprtp, sclrpthlp, &
1789 wpsclrp, edsclr_in, err_code, &
1790 rcm_out, wprcp_out, cloud_frac_out, ice_supersat_frac, &
1791 rcm_in_layer_out, cloud_cover_out, &
1792 khzm_out, khzt_out, qclvar_out, thlprcp_out, &
1793 pdf_params)
1794
1795 if (do_rainturb) then
1796 rvm_in = rtm_in - rcm_out
1797 call update_xp2_mc_tndcy(pverp, dtime, cloud_frac_out, &
1798 rcm_out, rvm_in, thlm_in, wm_zt, exner, pre_in, pdf_params, &
1799 rtp2_mc_out, thlp2_mc_out, &
1800 wprtp_mc_out, wpthlp_mc_out, &
1801 rtpthlp_mc_out)
1802
1803 if (clubb_do_deep) then
1804 dum1 = 1._r8
1805 else
1806 dum1 = (1._r8 - cam_in%landfrac(i))
1807 end if
1808
1809 ! update turbulent moments based on rain evaporation
1810 rtp2_in = rtp2_in + dum1 * rtp2_mc_out * dtime
1811 thlp2_in = thlp2_in + dum1 * thlp2_mc_out * dtime
1812 if (.not. clubb_do_deep) then
1813 wprtp_in = wprtp_in + dum1 * wprtp_mc_out * dtime
1814 wpthlp_in = wpthlp_in + dum1 * wpthlp_mc_out * dtime
1815 endif
1816! rtpthlp_in = rtpthlp_in + rtpthlp_mc_out * dtime
1817 endif
1818
1819 if (do_cldcool) then
1820
1821 rcm_out_zm = zt2zm(rcm_out)
1822 qrl_zm = zt2zm(qrl_clubb)
1823 thlp2_rad_out(:) = 0._r8
1824 call calculate_thlp2_rad(pverp, rcm_out_zm, thlprcp_out, qrl_zm, thlp2_rad_out)
1825 thlp2_in = thlp2_in + thlp2_rad_out * dtime
1826 thlp2_in = max(thl_tol**2,thlp2_in)
1827 endif
1828
1829 ! Check to see if stats should be output, here stats are read into
1830 ! output arrays to make them conformable to CAM output
1831 if (l_stats) call stats_end_timestep_clubb(lchnk,i,out_zt,out_zm,&
1832 out_radzt,out_radzm,out_sfc)
1833
1834 enddo ! end time loop
1835
1836 if (clubb_do_adv) then
1837 if (macmic_it .eq. cld_macmic_num_steps) then
1838 wp2_in=zm2zt(wp2_in)
1839 wpthlp_in=zm2zt(wpthlp_in)
1840 wprtp_in=zm2zt(wprtp_in)
1841 up2_in=zm2zt(up2_in)
1842 vp2_in=zm2zt(vp2_in)
1843 thlp2_in=zm2zt(thlp2_in)
1844 rtp2_in=zm2zt(rtp2_in)
1845 rtpthlp_in=zm2zt(rtpthlp_in)
1846
1847 do k=1,pverp
1848 thlp2_in(k)=max(thl_tol**2,thlp2_in(k))
1849 rtp2_in(k)=max(rt_tol**2,rtp2_in(k))
1850 wp2_in(k)=max(w_tol_sqd,wp2_in(k))
1851 up2_in(k)=max(w_tol_sqd,up2_in(k))
1852 vp2_in(k)=max(w_tol_sqd,vp2_in(k))
1853 enddo
1854 endif
1855 endif
1856
1857 call cleanup_grid()
1858
1859 ! Arrays need to be "flipped" to CAM grid
1860 do k=1,pverp
1861
1862 um(i,k) = um_in(pverp-k+1)
1863 vm(i,k) = vm_in(pverp-k+1)
1864 upwp(i,k) = upwp_in(pverp-k+1)
1865 vpwp(i,k) = vpwp_in(pverp-k+1)
1866 up2(i,k) = up2_in(pverp-k+1)
1867 vp2(i,k) = vp2_in(pverp-k+1)
1868 thlm(i,k) = thlm_in(pverp-k+1)
1869 rtm(i,k) = rtm_in(pverp-k+1)
1870 wprtp(i,k) = wprtp_in(pverp-k+1)
1871 wpthlp(i,k) = wpthlp_in(pverp-k+1)
1872 wp2(i,k) = wp2_in(pverp-k+1)
1873 wp3(i,k) = wp3_in(pverp-k+1)
1874 rtp2(i,k) = rtp2_in(pverp-k+1)
1875 thlp2(i,k) = thlp2_in(pverp-k+1)
1876 rtpthlp(i,k) = rtpthlp_in(pverp-k+1)
1877 rcm(i,k) = rcm_out(pverp-k+1)
1878 wprcp(i,k) = wprcp_out(pverp-k+1)
1879 cloud_frac(i,k) = min(cloud_frac_out(pverp-k+1),1._r8)
1880 rcm_in_layer(i,k) = rcm_in_layer_out(pverp-k+1)
1881 cloud_cover(i,k) = min(cloud_cover_out(pverp-k+1),1._r8)
1882 zt_out(i,k) = zt_g(pverp-k+1)
1883 zi_out(i,k) = zi_g(pverp-k+1)
1884 khzm(i,k) = khzm_out(pverp-k+1)
1885 khzt(i,k) = khzt_out(pverp-k+1)
1886 qclvar(i,k) = min(1._r8,qclvar_out(pverp-k+1))
1887
1888 do ixind=1,edsclr_dim
1889 edsclr_out(k,ixind) = edsclr_in(pverp-k+1,ixind)
1890 enddo
1891
1892 enddo
1893
1894 ! Fill up arrays needed for McICA. Note we do not want the ghost point,
1895 ! thus why the second loop is needed.
1896
1897 zi_out(i,1) = 0._r8
1898
1899 ! Compute integrals for static energy, kinetic energy, water vapor, and liquid water
1900 ! after CLUBB is called. This is for energy conservation purposes.
1901 se_a = 0._r8
1902 ke_a = 0._r8
1903 wv_a = 0._r8
1904 wl_a = 0._r8
1905 do k=1,pver
1906 clubb_s(k) = cpair*((thlm(i,k)+(latvap/cpair)*rcm(i,k))/exner_clubb(i,k))+ &
1907 gravit*state1%zm(i,k)+state1%phis(i)
1908 se_a(i) = se_a(i) + clubb_s(k)*state1%pdel(i,k)/gravit
1909 ke_a(i) = ke_a(i) + 0.5_r8*(um(i,k)**2+vm(i,k)**2)*state1%pdel(i,k)/gravit
1910 wv_a(i) = wv_a(i) + (rtm(i,k)-rcm(i,k))*state1%pdel(i,k)/gravit
1911 wl_a(i) = wl_a(i) + (rcm(i,k))*state1%pdel(i,k)/gravit
1912 enddo
1913
1914 ! Based on these integrals, compute the total energy before and after CLUBB call
1915 do k=1,pver
1916 te_a(i) = se_a(i) + ke_a(i) + (latvap+latice)*wv_a(i)+latice*wl_a(i)
1917 te_b(i) = se_b(i) + ke_b(i) + (latvap+latice)*wv_b(i)+latice*wl_b(i)
1918 enddo
1919
1920 ! Take into account the surface fluxes of heat and moisture
1921 te_b(i) = te_b(i)+(cam_in%shf(i)+(cam_in%lhf(i)/latvap)*(latvap+latice))*hdtime
1922
1923 ! Compute the disbalance of total energy
1924 se_dis = (te_a(i) - te_b(i))/(state1%ps(i)-state1%pint(i,1))
1925
1926 ! Fix the total energy coming out of CLUBB so it achieves enery conservation.
1927 ! Apply this fixer throughout the column evenly.
1928 do k=1,pver
1929 clubb_s(k) = clubb_s(k) - se_dis*gravit
1930 enddo
1931
1932 ! Now compute the tendencies of CLUBB to CAM, note that pverp is the ghost point
1933 ! for all variables and therefore is never called in this loop
1934 do k=1,pver
1935
1936 ptend_loc%u(i,k) = (um(i,k)-state1%u(i,k))/hdtime ! east-west wind
1937 ptend_loc%v(i,k) = (vm(i,k)-state1%v(i,k))/hdtime ! north-south wind
1938 ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixq) = (rtm(i,k)-rcm(i,k)-state1%q(i,k,ixq))/hdtime ! water vapor
1939 ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixcldliq) = (rcm(i,k)-state1%q(i,k,ixcldliq))/hdtime ! Tendency of liquid water
1940 ptend_loc%s(i,k) = (clubb_s(k)-state1%s(i,k))/hdtime ! Tendency of static energy
1941
1942 if (clubb_do_adv) then
1943 if (macmic_it .eq. cld_macmic_num_steps) then
1944
1945 ! Here add a constant to moments which can be either positive or
1946 ! negative. This is to prevent clipping when dynamics tries to
1947 ! make all constituents positive
1948 wp3(i,k) = wp3(i,k) + wp3_const
1949 rtpthlp(i,k) = rtpthlp(i,k) + rtpthlp_const
1950 wpthlp(i,k) = wpthlp(i,k) + wpthlp_const
1951 wprtp(i,k) = wprtp(i,k) + wprtp_const
1952
1953 ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixthlp2)=(thlp2(i,k)-state1%q(i,k,ixthlp2))/hdtime ! THLP Variance
1954 ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixrtp2)=(rtp2(i,k)-state1%q(i,k,ixrtp2))/hdtime ! RTP Variance
1955 ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixrtpthlp)=(rtpthlp(i,k)-state1%q(i,k,ixrtpthlp))/hdtime ! RTP THLP covariance
1956 ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixwpthlp)=(wpthlp(i,k)-state1%q(i,k,ixwpthlp))/hdtime ! WPTHLP
1957 ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixwprtp)=(wprtp(i,k)-state1%q(i,k,ixwprtp))/hdtime ! WPRTP
1958 ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixwp2)=(wp2(i,k)-state1%q(i,k,ixwp2))/hdtime ! WP2
1959 ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixwp3)=(wp3(i,k)-state1%q(i,k,ixwp3))/hdtime ! WP3
1960 ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixup2)=(up2(i,k)-state1%q(i,k,ixup2))/hdtime ! UP2
1961 ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixvp2)=(vp2(i,k)-state1%q(i,k,ixvp2))/hdtime ! VP2
1962 else
1963 ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixthlp2)=0._r8
1964 ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixrtp2)=0._r8
1965 ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixrtpthlp)=0._r8
1966 ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixwpthlp)=0._r8
1967 ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixwprtp)=0._r8
1968 ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixwp2)=0._r8
1969 ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixwp3)=0._r8
1970 ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixup2)=0._r8
1971 ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixvp2)=0._r8
1972 endif
1973
1974 endif
1975
1976 ! Apply tendencies to ice mixing ratio, liquid and ice number, and aerosol constituents.
1977 ! Loading up this array doesn't mean the tendencies are applied.
1978 ! edsclr_out is compressed with just the constituents being used, ptend and state are not compressed
1979
1980 icnt=0
1981 do ixind=1,pcnst
1982 if (lq(ixind)) then
1983 icnt=icnt+1
1984 if ((ixind /= ixq) .and. (ixind /= ixcldliq) .and.&
1985 (ixind /= ixthlp2) .and. (ixind /= ixrtp2) .and.&
1986 (ixind /= ixrtpthlp) .and. (ixind /= ixwpthlp) .and.&
1987 (ixind /= ixwprtp) .and. (ixind /= ixwp2) .and.&
1988 (ixind /= ixwp3) .and. (ixind /= ixup2) .and. (ixind /= ixvp2) ) then
1989 ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixind) = (edsclr_out(k,icnt)-state1%q(i,k,ixind))/hdtime ! transported constituents
1990 end if
1991 end if
1992 enddo
1993
1994 enddo
1995
1996 enddo ! end column loop
1997
1998 ! Add constant to ghost point so that output is not corrupted
1999 if (clubb_do_adv) then
2000 if (macmic_it .eq. cld_macmic_num_steps) then
2001 wp3(:,pverp) = wp3(:,pverp) + wp3_const
2002 rtpthlp(:,pverp) = rtpthlp(:,pverp) + rtpthlp_const
2003 wpthlp(:,pverp) = wpthlp(:,pverp) + wpthlp_const
2004 wprtp(:,pverp) = wprtp(:,pverp) + wprtp_const
2005 endif
2006 endif
2007
2008 cmeliq(:,:) = ptend_loc%q(:,:,ixcldliq)
2009
2010 ! ------------------------------------------------- !
2011 ! End column computation of CLUBB, begin to apply !
2012 ! and compute output, etc !
2013 ! ------------------------------------------------- !
2014
2015 ! Output CLUBB tendencies
2016 call outfld( 'RVMTEND_CLUBB', ptend_loc%q(:,:,ixq), pcols, lchnk)
2017 call outfld( 'RCMTEND_CLUBB', ptend_loc%q(:,:,ixcldliq), pcols, lchnk)
2018 call outfld( 'RIMTEND_CLUBB', ptend_loc%q(:,:,ixcldice), pcols, lchnk)
2019 call outfld( 'STEND_CLUBB', ptend_loc%s,pcols, lchnk)
2020 call outfld( 'UTEND_CLUBB', ptend_loc%u,pcols, lchnk)
2021 call outfld( 'VTEND_CLUBB', ptend_loc%v,pcols, lchnk)
2022
2023 if (clubb_do_deep) call outfld( 'MU_CLUBB', varmu ,pcols, lchnk)
2024
2025 call outfld( 'CMELIQ', cmeliq, pcols, lchnk)
2026
2027 ! Update physics tendencies
2028 if (.not. micro_do_icesupersat) then
2029 call physics_ptend_init(ptend_all, state%psetcols, 'clubb')
2030 endif
2031 call physics_ptend_sum(ptend_loc,ptend_all,ncol)
2032 call physics_update(state1,ptend_loc,hdtime)
2033
2034 ! ------------------------------------------------------------ !
2035 ! ------------------------------------------------------------ !
2036 ! ------------------------------------------------------------ !
2037 ! The rest of the code deals with diagnosing variables !
2038 ! for microphysics/radiation computation and macrophysics !
2039 ! ------------------------------------------------------------ !
2040 ! ------------------------------------------------------------ !
2041 ! ------------------------------------------------------------ !
2042
2043
2044 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2045 ! COMPUTE THE ICE CLOUD DETRAINMENT !
2046 ! Detrainment of convective condensate into the environment or stratiform cloud !
2047 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2048
2049 ! Initialize the shallow convective detrainment rate, will always be zero
2050 dlf2(:,:) = 0.0_r8
2051
2052 lqice(:) = .false.
2053 lqice(ixcldliq) = .true.
2054 lqice(ixcldice) = .true.
2055 lqice(ixnumliq) = .true.
2056 lqice(ixnumice) = .true.
2057
2058 call physics_ptend_init(ptend_loc,state%psetcols, 'clubb', ls=.true., lq=lqice)
2059
2060 do k=1,pver
2061 do i=1,ncol
2062 if( state1%t(i,k) > 268.15_r8 ) then
2063 dum1 = 0.0_r8
2064 elseif ( state1%t(i,k) < 238.15_r8 ) then
2065 dum1 = 1.0_r8
2066 else
2067 dum1 = ( 268.15_r8 - state1%t(i,k) ) / 30._r8
2068 endif
2069
2070 ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixcldliq) = dlf(i,k) * ( 1._r8 - dum1 )
2071 ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixcldice) = dlf(i,k) * dum1
2072 ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixnumliq) = 3._r8 * ( max(0._r8, ( dlf(i,k) - dlf2(i,k) )) * ( 1._r8 - dum1 ) ) &
2073 / (4._r8*3.14_r8* 8.e-6_r8**3*997._r8) + & ! Deep Convection
2074 3._r8 * ( dlf2(i,k) * ( 1._r8 - dum1 ) ) &
2075 / (4._r8*3.14_r8*10.e-6_r8**3*997._r8) ! Shallow Convection
2076 ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixnumice) = 3._r8 * ( max(0._r8, ( dlf(i,k) - dlf2(i,k) )) * dum1 ) &
2077 / (4._r8*3.14_r8*25.e-6_r8**3*500._r8) + & ! Deep Convection
2078 3._r8 * ( dlf2(i,k) * dum1 ) &
2079 / (4._r8*3.14_r8*50.e-6_r8**3*500._r8) ! Shallow Convection
2080 ptend_loc%s(i,k) = dlf(i,k) * dum1 * latice
2081
2082 ! Only rliq is saved from deep convection, which is the reserved liquid. We need to keep
2083 ! track of the integrals of ice and static energy that is effected from conversion to ice
2084 ! so that the energy checker doesn't complain.
2085 det_s(i) = det_s(i) + ptend_loc%s(i,k)*state1%pdel(i,k)/gravit
2086 det_ice(i) = det_ice(i) - ptend_loc%q(i,k,ixcldice)*state1%pdel(i,k)/gravit
2087
2088 enddo
2089 enddo
2090
2091 det_ice(:ncol) = det_ice(:ncol)/1000._r8 ! divide by density of water
2092
2093 call outfld( 'DPDLFLIQ', ptend_loc%q(:,:,ixcldliq), pcols, lchnk)
2094 call outfld( 'DPDLFICE', ptend_loc%q(:,:,ixcldice), pcols, lchnk)
2095 call outfld( 'DPDLFT', ptend_loc%s(:,:)/cpair, pcols, lchnk)
2096
2097 call physics_ptend_sum(ptend_loc,ptend_all,ncol)
2098 call physics_update(state1,ptend_loc,hdtime)
2099
2100 ! ------------------------------------------------- !
2101 ! Diagnose relative cloud water variance !
2102 ! ------------------------------------------------- !
2103
2104 if (deep_scheme .eq. 'CLUBB_SGS') then
2105 relvarmax = 2.0_r8
2106 else
2107 relvarmax = 10.0_r8
2108 endif
2109
2110 relvar(:,:) = relvarmax ! default
2111
2112 if (deep_scheme .ne. 'CLUBB_SGS') then
2113 where (rcm(:ncol,:pver) /= 0 .and. qclvar(:ncol,:pver) /= 0) &
2114 relvar(:ncol,:pver) = min(relvarmax,max(0.001_r8,rcm(:ncol,:pver)**2/qclvar(:ncol,:pver)))
2115 endif
2116
2117 ! ------------------------------------------------- !
2118 ! Optional Accretion enhancement factor !
2119 ! ------------------------------------------------- !
2120
2121 accre_enhan(:ncol,:pver) = 1._r8
2122
2123 ! ------------------------------------------------- !
2124 ! Diagnose some output variables !
2125 ! ------------------------------------------------- !
2126
2127 ! density
2128 rho(:ncol,1:pver) = state1%pmid(:ncol,1:pver)/(rair*state1%t(:ncol,1:pver))
2129 rho(:ncol,pverp) = state1%ps(:ncol)/(rair*state1%t(:ncol,pver))
2130
2131 eps = rair/rh2o
2132 wpthvp(:,:) = 0.0_r8
2133 do k=1,pver
2134 do i=1,ncol
2135 ! buoyancy flux
2136 wpthvp(i,k) = (wpthlp(i,k)-(apply_const*wpthlp_const))+((1._r8-eps)/eps)*theta0* &
2137 (wprtp(i,k)-(apply_const*wprtp_const))+((latvap/cpair)* &
2138 state1%exner(i,k)-(1._r8/eps)*theta0)*wprcp(i,k)
2139
2140 ! total water mixing ratio
2141 qt_output(i,k) = state1%q(i,k,ixq)+state1%q(i,k,ixcldliq)+state1%q(i,k,ixcldice)
2142 ! liquid water potential temperature
2143 thetal_output(i,k) = (state1%t(i,k)*state1%exner(i,k))-(latvap/cpair)*state1%q(i,k,ixcldliq)
2144 ! liquid water static energy
2145 sl_output(i,k) = cpair*state1%t(i,k)+gravit*state1%zm(i,k)-latvap*state1%q(i,k,ixcldliq)
2146 enddo
2147 enddo
2148
2149 do k=1,pverp
2150 do i=1,ncol
2151 wpthlp_output(i,k) = (wpthlp(i,k)-(apply_const*wpthlp_const))*rho(i,k)*cpair ! liquid water potential temperature flux
2152 wprtp_output(i,k) = (wprtp(i,k)-(apply_const*wprtp_const))*rho(i,k)*latvap ! total water mixig ratio flux
2153 rtpthlp_output(i,k) = rtpthlp(i,k)-(apply_const*rtpthlp_const) ! rtpthlp output
2154 wp3_output(i,k) = wp3(i,k) - (apply_const*wp3_const) ! wp3 output
2155 tke(i,k) = 0.5_r8*(up2(i,k)+vp2(i,k)+wp2(i,k)) ! turbulent kinetic energy
2156 enddo
2157 enddo
2158
2159 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2160 ! Diagnose some quantities that are computed in macrop_tend here. !
2161 ! These are inputs required for the microphysics calculation. !
2162 ! !
2163 ! FIRST PART COMPUTES THE STRATIFORM CLOUD FRACTION FROM CLUBB CLOUD FRACTION !
2164 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2165
2166 ! initialize variables
2167 alst(:,:) = 0.0_r8
2168 qlst(:,:) = 0.0_r8
2169
2170 do k=1,pver
2171 do i=1,ncol
2172 alst(i,k) = cloud_frac(i,k)
2173 qlst(i,k) = rcm(i,k)/max(0.01_r8,alst(i,k)) ! Incloud stratus condensate mixing ratio
2174 enddo
2175 enddo
2176
2177 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2178 ! THIS PART COMPUTES CONVECTIVE AND DEEP CONVECTIVE CLOUD FRACTION !
2179 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2180
2181 deepcu(:,pver) = 0.0_r8
2182 shalcu(:,pver) = 0.0_r8
2183
2184 do k=1,pver-1
2185 do i=1,ncol
2186 ! diagnose the deep convective cloud fraction, as done in macrophysics based on the
2187 ! deep convective mass flux, read in from pbuf. Since shallow convection is never
2188 ! called, the shallow convective mass flux will ALWAYS be zero, ensuring that this cloud
2189 ! fraction is purely from deep convection scheme.
2190 deepcu(i,k) = max(0.0_r8,min(0.1_r8*log(1.0_r8+500.0_r8*(cmfmc(i,k+1)-cmfmc2(i,k+1))),0.6_r8))
2191 shalcu(i,k) = 0._r8
2192
2193 if (deepcu(i,k) <= frac_limit .or. dp_icwmr(i,k) < ic_limit) then
2194 deepcu(i,k) = 0._r8
2195 endif
2196
2197 ! using the deep convective cloud fraction, and CLUBB cloud fraction (variable
2198 ! "cloud_frac"), compute the convective cloud fraction. This follows the formulation
2199 ! found in macrophysics code. Assumes that convective cloud is all nonstratiform cloud
2200 ! from CLUBB plus the deep convective cloud fraction
2201 concld(i,k) = min(cloud_frac(i,k)-alst(i,k)+deepcu(i,k),0.80_r8)
2202 enddo
2203 enddo
2204
2205 if (single_column) then
2206 if (trim(scm_clubb_iop_name) .eq. 'ATEX_48hr' .or. &
2207 trim(scm_clubb_iop_name) .eq. 'BOMEX_5day' .or. &
2208 trim(scm_clubb_iop_name) .eq. 'DYCOMSrf01_4day' .or. &
2209 trim(scm_clubb_iop_name) .eq. 'DYCOMSrf02_06hr' .or. &
2210 trim(scm_clubb_iop_name) .eq. 'RICO_3day' .or. &
2211 trim(scm_clubb_iop_name) .eq. 'ARM_CC') then
2212
2213 deepcu(:,:) = 0.0_r8
2214 concld(:,:) = 0.0_r8
2215
2216 endif
2217 endif
2218
2219 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2220 ! COMPUTE THE ICE CLOUD FRACTION PORTION !
2221 ! use the aist_vector function to compute the ice cloud fraction !
2222 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2223
2224 do k=1,pver
2225 call aist_vector(state1%q(:,k,ixq),state1%t(:,k),state1%pmid(:,k),state1%q(:,k,ixcldice), &
2226 state1%q(:,k,ixnumice),cam_in%landfrac(:),cam_in%snowhland(:),aist(:,k),ncol)
2227 enddo
2228
2229 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2230 ! THIS PART COMPUTES THE LIQUID STRATUS FRACTION !
2231 ! !
2232 ! For now leave the computation of ice stratus fraction from macrop_driver intact !
2233 ! because CLUBB does nothing with ice. Here I simply overwrite the liquid stratus !
2234 ! fraction that was coded in macrop_driver !
2235 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2236
2237 ! Recompute net stratus fraction using maximum over-lapping assumption, as done
2238 ! in macrophysics code, using alst computed above and aist read in from physics buffer
2239
2240 cldthresh=1.e-18_r8
2241
2242 do k=1,pver
2243 do i=1,ncol
2244
2245 ast(i,k) = max(alst(i,k),aist(i,k))
2246
2247 qist(i,k) = state1%q(i,k,ixcldice)/max(0.01_r8,aist(i,k))
2248 enddo
2249 enddo
2250
2251 ! Probably need to add deepcu cloud fraction to the cloud fraction array, else would just
2252 ! be outputting the shallow convective cloud fraction
2253
2254 do k=1,pver
2255 do i=1,ncol
2256 cloud_frac(i,k) = min(ast(i,k)+deepcu(i,k),1.0_r8)
2257 enddo
2258 enddo
2259
2260 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2261 ! DIAGNOSE THE PBL DEPTH !
2262 ! this is needed for aerosol code !
2263 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2264
2265 do i=1,ncol
2266 do k=1,pver
2267 th(i,k) = state1%t(i,k)*state1%exner(i,k)
2268 thv(i,k) = th(i,k)*(1.0_r8+zvir*state1%q(i,k,ixq))
2269 enddo
2270 enddo
2271
2272 ! diagnose surface friction and obukhov length (inputs to diagnose PBL depth)
2273 do i=1,ncol
2274 rrho = (1._r8/gravit)*(state1%pdel(i,pver)/dz_g(pver))
2275 call calc_ustar( state1%t(i,pver), state1%pmid(i,pver), cam_in%wsx(i), cam_in%wsy(i), &
2276 rrho, ustar2(i) )
2277 call calc_obklen( th(i,pver), thv(i,pver), cam_in%lhf(i)/latvap, cam_in%shf(i), rrho, ustar2(i), &
2278 kinheat(i), kinwat(i), kbfs(i), obklen(i) )
2279 enddo
2280
2281 dummy2(:) = 0._r8
2282 dummy3(:) = 0._r8
2283
2284 where (kbfs .eq. -0.0_r8) kbfs = 0.0_r8
2285
2286 ! Compute PBL depth according to Holtslag-Boville Scheme
2287 call pblintd(ncol, thv, state1%zm, state1%u, state1%v, &
2288 ustar2, obklen, kbfs, pblh, dummy2, &
2289 state1%zi, cloud_frac(:,1:pver), 1._r8-cam_in%landfrac, dummy3)
2290
2291 ! Output the PBL depth
2292 call outfld('PBLH', pblh, pcols, lchnk)
2293
2294 ! Assign the first pver levels of cloud_frac back to cld
2295 cld(:,1:pver) = cloud_frac(:,1:pver)
2296
2297 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2298 ! END CLOUD FRACTION DIAGNOSIS, begin to store variables back into buffer !
2299 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2300
2301 ! Output calls of variables goes here
2302 call outfld( 'RELVAR', relvar, pcols, lchnk )
2303 call outfld( 'RHO_CLUBB', rho, pcols, lchnk )
2304 call outfld( 'WP2_CLUBB', wp2, pcols, lchnk )
2305 call outfld( 'UP2_CLUBB', up2, pcols, lchnk )
2306 call outfld( 'VP2_CLUBB', vp2, pcols, lchnk )
2307 call outfld( 'WP3_CLUBB', wp3_output, pcols, lchnk )
2308 call outfld( 'UPWP_CLUBB', upwp, pcols, lchnk )
2309 call outfld( 'VPWP_CLUBB', vpwp, pcols, lchnk )
2310 call outfld( 'WPTHLP_CLUBB', wpthlp_output, pcols, lchnk )
2311 call outfld( 'WPRTP_CLUBB', wprtp_output, pcols, lchnk )
2312 call outfld( 'RTP2_CLUBB', rtp2*1000._r8, pcols, lchnk )
2313 call outfld( 'THLP2_CLUBB', thlp2, pcols, lchnk )
2314 call outfld( 'RTPTHLP_CLUBB', rtpthlp_output*1000._r8, pcols, lchnk )
2315 call outfld( 'RCM_CLUBB', rcm*1000._r8, pcols, lchnk )
2316 call outfld( 'WPRCP_CLUBB', wprcp*latvap, pcols, lchnk )
2317 call outfld( 'CLOUDFRAC_CLUBB', alst, pcols, lchnk )
2318 call outfld( 'RCMINLAYER_CLUBB', rcm_in_layer*1000._r8, pcols, lchnk )
2319 call outfld( 'CLOUDCOVER_CLUBB', cloud_frac, pcols, lchnk )
2320 call outfld( 'WPTHVP_CLUBB', wpthvp*cpair, pcols, lchnk )
2321 call outfld( 'ZT_CLUBB', 1._r8*zt_out, pcols, lchnk )
2322 call outfld( 'ZM_CLUBB', 1._r8*zi_out, pcols, lchnk )
2323 call outfld( 'UM_CLUBB', um, pcols, lchnk )
2324 call outfld( 'VM_CLUBB', vm, pcols, lchnk )
2325 call outfld( 'THETAL', thetal_output, pcols, lchnk )
2326 call outfld( 'QT', qt_output, pcols, lchnk )
2327 call outfld( 'SL', sl_output, pcols, lchnk )
2328 call outfld( 'CONCLD', concld, pcols, lchnk )
2329
2330 ! Output CLUBB history here
2331 if (l_stats) then
2332
2333 do i=1,zt%nn
2334
2335 temp1 = trim(zt%f%var(i)%name)
2336 sub = temp1
2337 if (len(temp1) .gt. 16) sub = temp1(1:16)
2338
2339 call outfld(trim(sub), out_zt(:,:,i), pcols, lchnk )
2340 enddo
2341
2342 do i=1,zm%nn
2343
2344 temp1 = trim(zm%f%var(i)%name)
2345 sub = temp1
2346 if (len(temp1) .gt. 16) sub = temp1(1:16)
2347
2348 call outfld(trim(sub),out_zm(:,:,i), pcols, lchnk)
2349 enddo
2350
2351 if (l_output_rad_files) then
2352 do i=1,rad_zt%nn
2353 call outfld(trim(rad_zt%f%var(i)%name), out_radzt(:,:,i), pcols, lchnk)
2354 enddo
2355
2356 do i=1,rad_zm%nn
2357 call outfld(trim(rad_zm%f%var(i)%name), out_radzm(:,:,i), pcols, lchnk)
2358 enddo
2359 endif
2360
2361 do i=1,sfc%nn
2362 call outfld(trim(sfc%f%var(i)%name), out_sfc(:,:,i), pcols, lchnk)
2363 enddo
2364
2365 endif
2366
2367 return
2368#endif
2369 end subroutine clubb_tend_cam
2370

2372 ! !
2373 ! =============================================================================== !
2374
2375 subroutine clubb_surface (state, ptend, ztodt, cam_in, ustar, obklen)
2376
2377!-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2378! Description: Provide the obukov length and the surface friction velocity
2379! for the dry deposition code in routine tphysac. Since University
2380! of Washington Moist Turbulence (UWMT) scheme is not called when
2381! CLUBB is turned on the obukov length and ustar are never initialized
2382! nor computed (sometimes never updated from NaN). In addition, surface
2383! fluxes are applied to the constituents.
2384!
2385! Author: Peter Bogenschutz, August 2011
2386! Origin: Based heavily on UWMT code (eddy_diff.F90)
2387! References:
2388! None
2389!-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2390
2391 use physics_types, only: physics_state, physics_ptend, physics_ptend_init
2392 use physconst, only: gravit, zvir, latvap
2393 use ppgrid, only: pver, pcols
2394 use constituents, only: pcnst, cnst_get_ind
2395 use camsrfexch, only: cam_in_t
2396
2397 implicit none
2398
2399 ! --------------- !
2400 ! Input Auguments !
2401 ! --------------- !
2402
2403 type(physics_state), intent(in) :: state ! Physics state variables
2404 type(cam_in_t), intent(in) :: cam_in
2405
2406 real(r8), intent(in) :: ztodt ! 2 delta-t [ s ]
2407
2408 ! ---------------- !
2409 ! Output Auguments !
2410 ! ---------------- !
2411
2412 type(physics_ptend), intent(out) :: ptend ! Individual parameterization tendencies
2413 real(r8), intent(out) :: obklen(pcols) ! Obukhov length [ m ]
2414 real(r8), intent(out) :: ustar(pcols) ! Surface friction velocity [ m/s ]
2415
2416#ifdef CLUBB_SGS
2417
2418 ! --------------- !
2419 ! Local Variables !
2420 ! --------------- !
2421
2422 integer :: i ! indicees
2423 integer :: ncol ! # of atmospheric columns
2424
2425 real(r8) :: th(pcols) ! surface potential temperature
2426 real(r8) :: thv(pcols) ! surface virtual potential temperature
2427 real(r8) :: kinheat ! kinematic surface heat flux
2428 real(r8) :: kinwat ! kinematic surface vapor flux
2429 real(r8) :: kbfs ! kinematic surface buoyancy flux
2430 real(r8) :: tmp1(pcols)
2431 real(r8) :: rztodt ! 1./ztodt
2432 integer :: m
2433 integer :: ixq
2434 real(r8) :: rrho ! Inverse air density
2435
2436 logical :: lq(pcnst)
2437
2438#endif
2439 obklen(pcols) = 0.0_r8
2440 ustar(pcols) = 0.0_r8
2441#ifdef CLUBB_SGS
2442
2443 ! ----------------------- !
2444 ! Main Computation Begins !
2445 ! ----------------------- !
2446
2447
2448 call cnst_get_ind('Q',ixq)
2449
2450 lq(:) = .TRUE.
2451 call physics_ptend_init(ptend, state%psetcols, 'clubb', lq=lq)
2452
2453 ncol = state%ncol
2454
2455 ! Compute the surface friction velocity and obukov length
2456
2457 do i = 1, ncol
2458 th(i) = state%t(i,pver)*state%exner(i,pver) ! diagnose potential temperature
2459 thv(i) = th(i)*(1._r8+zvir*state%q(i,pver,ixq)) ! diagnose virtual potential temperature
2460 enddo
2461
2462 do i = 1, ncol
2463 call calc_ustar( state%t(i,pver), state%pmid(i,pver), cam_in%wsx(i), cam_in%wsy(i), &
2464 rrho, ustar(i) )
2465 call calc_obklen( th(i), thv(i), cam_in%lhf(i)/latvap, cam_in%shf(i), rrho, ustar(i), &
2466 kinheat, kinwat, kbfs, obklen(i) )
2467 enddo
2468
2469 rztodt = 1._r8/ztodt
2470 ptend%q(:ncol,:pver,:) = state%q(:ncol,:pver,:)
2471 tmp1(:ncol) = ztodt * gravit * state%rpdel(:ncol,pver)
2472
2473 do m = 2, pcnst
2474 ptend%q(:ncol,pver,m) = ptend%q(:ncol,pver,m) + tmp1(:ncol) * cam_in%cflx(:ncol,m)
2475 enddo
2476
2477 ptend%q(:ncol,:pver,:) = (ptend%q(:ncol,:pver,:) - state%q(:ncol,:pver,:)) * rztodt
2478
2479 return
2480
2481#endif
2482
2483 end subroutine clubb_surface
2484
2485#ifdef CLUBB_SGS
2486! ----------------------------------------------------------------------
2487!
2488! DISCLAIMER : this code appears to be correct but has not been
2489! very thouroughly tested. If you do notice any
2490! anomalous behaviour then please contact Andy and/or
2491! Bjorn
2492!
2493! Function diag_ustar: returns value of ustar using the below
2494! similarity functions and a specified buoyancy flux (bflx) given in
2495! kinematic units
2496!
2497! phi_m (zeta > 0) = (1 + am * zeta)
2498! phi_m (zeta < 0) = (1 - bm * zeta)^(-1/4)
2499!
2500! where zeta = z/lmo and lmo = (theta_rev/g*vonk) * (ustar^2/tstar)
2501!
2502! Ref: Businger, 1973, Turbulent Transfer in the Atmospheric Surface
2503! Layer, in Workshop on Micormeteorology, pages 67-100.
2504!
2505! Code writen March, 1999 by Bjorn Stevens
2506!
2507
2508real(r8) function diag_ustar( z, bflx, wnd, z0 )
2509
2510use shr_const_mod, only : shr_const_karman, shr_const_pi, shr_const_g
2511
2512implicit none
2513
2514real(r8), parameter :: am = 4.8_r8 ! " " "
2515real(r8), parameter :: bm = 19.3_r8 ! " " "
2516
2517real(r8), parameter :: grav = shr_const_g
2518real(r8), parameter :: vonk = shr_const_karman
2519real(r8), parameter :: pi = shr_const_pi
2520
2521real(r8), intent (in) :: z ! height where u locates
2522real(r8), intent (in) :: bflx ! surface buoyancy flux (m^2/s^3)
2523real(r8), intent (in) :: wnd ! wind speed at z
2524real(r8), intent (in) :: z0 ! momentum roughness height
2525
2526
2527integer :: iterate
2528real(r8) :: lnz, klnz, c1, x, psi1, zeta, lmo, ustar
2529
2530lnz = log( z / z0 )
2531klnz = vonk/lnz
2532c1 = pi / 2.0_r8 - 3.0_r8*log( 2.0_r8 )
2533
2534ustar = wnd*klnz
2535if (abs(bflx) > 1.e-6_r8) then
2536 do iterate=1,4
2537
2538 if (ustar > 1.e-6_r8) then
2539 lmo = -ustar**3 / ( vonk * bflx )
2540 zeta = z/lmo
2541 if (zeta > 0._r8) then
2542 ustar = vonk*wnd /(lnz + am*zeta)
2543 else
2544 x = sqrt( sqrt( 1.0_r8 - bm*zeta ) )
2545 psi1 = 2._r8*log( 1.0_r8+x ) + log( 1.0_r8+x*x ) - 2._r8*atan( x ) + c1
2546 ustar = wnd*vonk/(lnz - psi1)
2547 end if
2548
2549 endif
2550
2551 end do
2552end if
2553
2554
2555diag_ustar = ustar
2556
2557return
2558
2559
2560end function diag_ustar
2561#endif
2562
2563 ! =============================================================================== !
2564 ! !
2565 ! =============================================================================== !
2566
2567#ifdef CLUBB_SGS
2568
2569 subroutine stats_init_clubb( l_stats_in, stats_tsamp_in, stats_tout_in, &
2570 nnzp, nnrad_zt,nnrad_zm, delt )
2571 !
2572 ! Description: Initializes the statistics saving functionality of
2573 ! the CLUBB model. This is for purpose of CAM-CLUBB interface. Here
2574 ! the traditional stats_init of CLUBB is not called, as it is not compatible
2575 ! with CAM output.
2576
2577 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2578
2579
2580 use stats_variables, only: &
2581 zt, & ! Variables
2582 ztscr01, &
2583 ztscr02, &
2584 ztscr03, &
2585 ztscr04, &
2586 ztscr05, &
2587 ztscr06, &
2588 ztscr07, &
2589 ztscr08, &
2590 ztscr09, &
2591 ztscr10, &
2592 ztscr11, &
2593 ztscr12, &
2594 ztscr13, &
2595 ztscr14, &
2596 ztscr15, &
2597 ztscr16, &
2598 ztscr17, &
2599 ztscr18, &
2600 ztscr19, &
2601 ztscr20, &
2602 ztscr21
2603
2604 use stats_variables, only: &
2605 zm, &
2606 zmscr01, &
2607 zmscr02, &
2608 zmscr03, &
2609 zmscr04, &
2610 zmscr05, &
2611 zmscr06, &
2612 zmscr07, &
2613 zmscr08, &
2614 zmscr09, &
2615 zmscr10, &
2616 zmscr11, &
2617 zmscr12, &
2618 zmscr13, &
2619 zmscr14, &
2620 zmscr15, &
2621 zmscr16, &
2622 zmscr17, &
2623 rad_zt, &
2624 rad_zm, &
2625 sfc, &
2626 l_stats, &
2627 l_output_rad_files, &
2628 stats_tsamp, &
2629 stats_tout, &
2630 l_stats_samp, &
2631 l_stats_last, &
2632 fname_rad_zt, &
2633 fname_rad_zm, &
2634 fname_sfc, &
2635 l_netcdf, &
2636 l_grads
2637
2638 use clubb_precision, only: time_precision !
2639 use stats_zm, only: nvarmax_zm, stats_init_zm !
2640 use stats_zt, only: nvarmax_zt, stats_init_zt !
2641 use stats_rad_zt, only: nvarmax_rad_zt, stats_init_rad_zt !
2642 use stats_rad_zm, only: nvarmax_rad_zm, stats_init_rad_zm !
2643 use stats_sfc, only: nvarmax_sfc, stats_init_sfc !
2644 use error_code, only: clubb_at_least_debug_level !
2645 use constants_clubb, only: fstderr, var_length !
2646 use cam_history, only: addfld, phys_decomp
2647 use namelist_utils, only: find_group_name
2648 use units, only: getunit, freeunit
2649 use cam_abortutils, only: endrun
2650
2651 implicit none
2652
2653 ! Input Variables
2654
2655 logical, intent(in) :: l_stats_in ! Stats on? T/F
2656
2657 real(kind=time_precision), intent(in) :: &
2658 stats_tsamp_in, & ! Sampling interval [s]
2659 stats_tout_in ! Output interval [s]
2660
2661 integer, intent(in) :: nnzp ! Grid points in the vertical [count]
2662 integer, intent(in) :: nnrad_zt ! Grid points in the radiation grid [count]
2663 integer, intent(in) :: nnrad_zm ! Grid points in the radiation grid [count]
2664
2665 real(kind=time_precision), intent(in) :: delt ! Timestep (dtmain in CLUBB) [s]
2666
2667
2668 ! Local Variables
2669
2670 ! Namelist Variables
2671
2672 character(len=var_length), dimension(nvarmax_zt) :: clubb_vars_zt ! Variables on the thermodynamic levels
2673 character(len=var_length), dimension(nvarmax_zm) :: clubb_vars_zm ! Variables on the momentum levels
2674 character(len=var_length), dimension(nvarmax_rad_zt) :: clubb_vars_rad_zt ! Variables on the radiation levels
2675 character(len=var_length), dimension(nvarmax_rad_zm) :: clubb_vars_rad_zm ! Variables on the radiation levels
2676 character(len=var_length), dimension(nvarmax_sfc) :: clubb_vars_sfc ! Variables at the model surface
2677
2678 namelist /clubb_stats_nl/ &
2679 clubb_vars_zt, &
2680 clubb_vars_zm, &
2681 clubb_vars_rad_zt, &
2682 clubb_vars_rad_zm, &
2683 clubb_vars_sfc
2684
2685 ! Local Variables
2686
2687 logical :: l_error
2688
2689 character(len=200) :: fname, temp1, sub
2690
2691 integer :: i, ntot, read_status
2692 integer :: iunit
2693
2694 ! Initialize
2695 l_error = .false.
2696
2697 ! Set stats_variables variables with inputs from calling subroutine
2698 l_stats = l_stats_in
2699
2700 stats_tsamp = stats_tsamp_in
2701 stats_tout = stats_tout_in
2702
2703 if ( .not. l_stats ) then
2704 l_stats_samp = .false.
2705 l_stats_last = .false.
2706 return
2707 end if
2708
2709 ! Initialize namelist variables
2710
2711 clubb_vars_zt = ''
2712 clubb_vars_zm = ''
2713 clubb_vars_rad_zt = ''
2714 clubb_vars_rad_zm = ''
2715 clubb_vars_sfc = ''
2716
2717 ! Read variables to compute from the namelist
2718 if (masterproc) then
2719 iunit= getunit()
2720 open(unit=iunit,file="atm_in",status='old')
2721 call find_group_name(iunit, 'clubb_stats_nl', status=read_status)
2722 if (read_status == 0) then
2723 read(unit=iunit, nml=clubb_stats_nl, iostat=read_status)
2724 if (read_status /= 0) then
2725 call endrun('stats_init_clubb: error reading namelist')
2726 end if
2727 end if
2728 close(unit=iunit)
2729 call freeunit(iunit)
2730 end if
2731
2732#ifdef SPMD
2733 ! Broadcast namelist variables
2734 call mpibcast(clubb_vars_zt, var_length*nvarmax_zt, mpichar, 0, mpicom)
2735 call mpibcast(clubb_vars_zm, var_length*nvarmax_zm, mpichar, 0, mpicom)
2736 call mpibcast(clubb_vars_rad_zt, var_length*nvarmax_rad_zt, mpichar, 0, mpicom)
2737 call mpibcast(clubb_vars_rad_zm, var_length*nvarmax_rad_zm, mpichar, 0, mpicom)
2738 call mpibcast(clubb_vars_sfc, var_length*nvarmax_sfc, mpichar, 0, mpicom)
2739#endif
2740
2741 ! Hardcode these for use in CAM-CLUBB, don't want either
2742 l_netcdf = .false.
2743 l_grads = .false.
2744
2745 ! Check sampling and output frequencies
2746
2747 ! The model time step length, delt (which is dtmain), should multiply
2748 ! evenly into the statistical sampling time step length, stats_tsamp.
2749 if ( abs( stats_tsamp/delt - floor(stats_tsamp/delt) ) > 1.e-8_r8 ) then
2750 l_error = .true. ! This will cause the run to stop.
2751 write(fstderr,*) 'Error: stats_tsamp should be an even multiple of ', &
2752 'delt (which is dtmain). Check the appropriate ', &
2753 'model.in file.'
2754 write(fstderr,*) 'stats_tsamp = ', stats_tsamp
2755 write(fstderr,*) 'delt = ', delt
2756 endif
2757
2758 ! Initialize zt (mass points)
2759
2760 i = 1
2761 do while ( ichar(clubb_vars_zt(i)(1:1)) /= 0 .and. &
2762 len_trim(clubb_vars_zt(i)) /= 0 .and. &
2763 i <= nvarmax_zt )
2764 i = i + 1
2765 enddo
2766 ntot = i - 1
2767 if ( ntot == nvarmax_zt ) then
2768 write(fstderr,*) "There are more statistical variables listed in ", &
2769 "clubb_vars_zt than allowed for by nvarmax_zt."
2770 write(fstderr,*) "Check the number of variables listed for clubb_vars_zt ", &
2771 "in the stats namelist, or change nvarmax_zt."
2772 write(fstderr,*) "nvarmax_zt = ", nvarmax_zt
2773 call endrun ("stats_init_clubb: number of zt statistical variables exceeds limit")
2774 endif
2775
2776 zt%nn = ntot
2777 zt%kk = nnzp
2778
2779 allocate( zt%z( zt%kk ) )
2780
2781 allocate( zt%x( 1, 1, zt%kk, zt%nn ) )
2782 allocate( zt%n( 1, 1, zt%kk, zt%nn ) )
2783 allocate( zt%l_in_update( 1, 1, zt%kk, zt%nn ) )
2784 call stats_zero( zt%kk, zt%nn, zt%x, zt%n, zt%l_in_update )
2785
2786 allocate( zt%f%var( zt%nn ) )
2787 allocate( zt%f%z( zt%kk ) )
2788
2789 ! Allocate scratch space
2790
2791 allocate( ztscr01(zt%kk) )
2792 allocate( ztscr02(zt%kk) )
2793 allocate( ztscr03(zt%kk) )
2794 allocate( ztscr04(zt%kk) )
2795 allocate( ztscr05(zt%kk) )
2796 allocate( ztscr06(zt%kk) )
2797 allocate( ztscr07(zt%kk) )
2798 allocate( ztscr08(zt%kk) )
2799 allocate( ztscr09(zt%kk) )
2800 allocate( ztscr10(zt%kk) )
2801 allocate( ztscr11(zt%kk) )
2802 allocate( ztscr12(zt%kk) )
2803 allocate( ztscr13(zt%kk) )
2804 allocate( ztscr14(zt%kk) )
2805 allocate( ztscr15(zt%kk) )
2806 allocate( ztscr16(zt%kk) )
2807 allocate( ztscr17(zt%kk) )
2808 allocate( ztscr18(zt%kk) )
2809 allocate( ztscr19(zt%kk) )
2810 allocate( ztscr20(zt%kk) )
2811 allocate( ztscr21(zt%kk) )
2812
2813 ztscr01 = 0.0_r8
2814 ztscr02 = 0.0_r8
2815 ztscr03 = 0.0_r8
2816 ztscr04 = 0.0_r8
2817 ztscr05 = 0.0_r8
2818 ztscr06 = 0.0_r8
2819 ztscr07 = 0.0_r8
2820 ztscr08 = 0.0_r8
2821 ztscr09 = 0.0_r8
2822 ztscr10 = 0.0_r8
2823 ztscr11 = 0.0_r8
2824 ztscr12 = 0.0_r8
2825 ztscr13 = 0.0_r8
2826 ztscr14 = 0.0_r8
2827 ztscr15 = 0.0_r8
2828 ztscr16 = 0.0_r8
2829 ztscr17 = 0.0_r8
2830 ztscr18 = 0.0_r8
2831 ztscr19 = 0.0_r8
2832 ztscr20 = 0.0_r8
2833 ztscr21 = 0.0_r8
2834
2835 ! Default initialization for array indices for zt
2836
2837 call stats_init_zt( clubb_vars_zt, l_error )
2838
2839 ! Initialize zm (momentum points)
2840
2841 i = 1
2842 do while ( ichar(clubb_vars_zm(i)(1:1)) /= 0 .and. &
2843 len_trim(clubb_vars_zm(i)) /= 0 .and. &
2844 i <= nvarmax_zm )
2845 i = i + 1
2846 end do
2847 ntot = i - 1
2848 if ( ntot == nvarmax_zm ) then
2849 write(fstderr,*) "There are more statistical variables listed in ", &
2850 "clubb_vars_zm than allowed for by nvarmax_zm."
2851 write(fstderr,*) "Check the number of variables listed for clubb_vars_zm ", &
2852 "in the stats namelist, or change nvarmax_zm."
2853 write(fstderr,*) "nvarmax_zm = ", nvarmax_zm
2854 call endrun ("stats_init_clubb: number of zm statistical variables exceeds limit")
2855 endif
2856
2857 zm%nn = ntot
2858 zm%kk = nnzp
2859
2860 allocate( zm%z( zm%kk ) )
2861
2862 allocate( zm%x( 1, 1, zm%kk, zm%nn ) )
2863 allocate( zm%n( 1, 1, zm%kk, zm%nn ) )
2864 allocate( zm%l_in_update( 1, 1, zm%kk, zm%nn ) )
2865

2867
2868 allocate( zm%f%var( zm%nn ) )
2869 allocate( zm%f%z( zm%kk ) )
2870
2871 ! Allocate scratch space
2872
2873 allocate( zmscr01(zm%kk) )
2874 allocate( zmscr02(zm%kk) )
2875 allocate( zmscr03(zm%kk) )
2876 allocate( zmscr04(zm%kk) )
2877 allocate( zmscr05(zm%kk) )
2878 allocate( zmscr06(zm%kk) )
2879 allocate( zmscr07(zm%kk) )
2880 allocate( zmscr08(zm%kk) )
2881 allocate( zmscr09(zm%kk) )
2882 allocate( zmscr10(zm%kk) )
2883 allocate( zmscr11(zm%kk) )
2884 allocate( zmscr12(zm%kk) )
2885 allocate( zmscr13(zm%kk) )
2886 allocate( zmscr14(zm%kk) )
2887 allocate( zmscr15(zm%kk) )
2888 allocate( zmscr16(zm%kk) )
2889 allocate( zmscr17(zm%kk) )
2890
2891 zmscr01 = 0.0_r8
2892 zmscr02 = 0.0_r8
2893 zmscr03 = 0.0_r8
2894 zmscr04 = 0.0_r8
2895 zmscr05 = 0.0_r8
2896 zmscr06 = 0.0_r8
2897 zmscr07 = 0.0_r8
2898 zmscr08 = 0.0_r8
2899 zmscr09 = 0.0_r8
2900 zmscr10 = 0.0_r8
2901 zmscr11 = 0.0_r8
2902 zmscr12 = 0.0_r8
2903 zmscr13 = 0.0_r8
2904 zmscr14 = 0.0_r8
2905 zmscr15 = 0.0_r8
2906 zmscr16 = 0.0_r8
2907 zmscr17 = 0.0_r8
2908
2909 call stats_init_zm( clubb_vars_zm, l_error )
2910
2911 ! Initialize rad_zt (radiation points)
2912
2913 if (l_output_rad_files) then
2914
2915 i = 1
2916 do while ( ichar(clubb_vars_rad_zt(i)(1:1)) /= 0 .and. &
2917 len_trim(clubb_vars_rad_zt(i)) /= 0 .and. &
2918 i <= nvarmax_rad_zt )
2919 i = i + 1
2920 end do
2921 ntot = i - 1
2922 if ( ntot == nvarmax_rad_zt ) then
2923 write(fstderr,*) "There are more statistical variables listed in ", &
2924 "clubb_vars_rad_zt than allowed for by nvarmax_rad_zt."
2925 write(fstderr,*) "Check the number of variables listed for clubb_vars_rad_zt ", &
2926 "in the stats namelist, or change nvarmax_rad_zt."
2927 write(fstderr,*) "nvarmax_rad_zt = ", nvarmax_rad_zt
2928 call endrun ("stats_init_clubb: number of rad_zt statistical variables exceeds limit")
2929 endif
2930
2931 rad_zt%nn = ntot
2932 rad_zt%kk = nnrad_zt
2933
2934 allocate( rad_zt%z( rad_zt%kk ) )
2935
2936 allocate( rad_zt%x( 1, 1, rad_zt%kk, rad_zt%nn ) )
2937 allocate( rad_zt%n( 1, 1, rad_zt%kk, rad_zt%nn ) )
2938 allocate( rad_zt%l_in_update( 1, 1, rad_zt%kk, rad_zt%nn ) )
2939
2940 call stats_zero( rad_zt%kk, rad_zt%nn, rad_zt%x, rad_zt%n, rad_zt%l_in_update )
2941
2942 allocate( rad_zt%f%var( rad_zt%nn ) )
2943 allocate( rad_zt%f%z( rad_zt%kk ) )
2944
2945 fname = trim( fname_rad_zt )
2946
2947 call stats_init_rad_zt( clubb_vars_rad_zt, l_error )
2948
2949 ! Initialize rad_zm (radiation points)
2950
2951 i = 1
2952 do while ( ichar(clubb_vars_rad_zm(i)(1:1)) /= 0 .and. &
2953 len_trim(clubb_vars_rad_zm(i)) /= 0 .and. &
2954 i <= nvarmax_rad_zm )
2955 i = i + 1
2956 end do
2957 ntot = i - 1
2958 if ( ntot == nvarmax_rad_zm ) then
2959 write(fstderr,*) "There are more statistical variables listed in ", &
2960 "clubb_vars_rad_zm than allowed for by nvarmax_rad_zm."
2961 write(fstderr,*) "Check the number of variables listed for clubb_vars_rad_zm ", &
2962 "in the stats namelist, or change nvarmax_rad_zm."
2963 write(fstderr,*) "nvarmax_rad_zm = ", nvarmax_rad_zm
2964 call endrun ("stats_init_clubb: number of rad_zm statistical variables exceeds limit")
2965 endif
2966
2967 rad_zm%nn = ntot
2968 rad_zm%kk = nnrad_zm
2969
2970 allocate( rad_zm%z( rad_zm%kk ) )
2971
2972 allocate( rad_zm%x( 1, 1, rad_zm%kk, rad_zm%nn ) )
2973 allocate( rad_zm%n( 1, 1, rad_zm%kk, rad_zm%nn ) )
2974 allocate( rad_zm%l_in_update( 1, 1, rad_zm%kk, rad_zm%nn ) )
2975
2976 call stats_zero( rad_zm%kk, rad_zm%nn, rad_zm%x, rad_zm%n, rad_zm%l_in_update )
2977
2978 allocate( rad_zm%f%var( rad_zm%nn ) )
2979 allocate( rad_zm%f%z( rad_zm%kk ) )
2980
2981
2982 fname = trim( fname_rad_zm )
2983
2984 call stats_init_rad_zm( clubb_vars_rad_zm, l_error )
2985 end if ! l_output_rad_files
2986
2987
2988 ! Initialize sfc (surface point)
2989
2990 i = 1
2991 do while ( ichar(clubb_vars_sfc(i)(1:1)) /= 0 .and. &
2992 len_trim(clubb_vars_sfc(i)) /= 0 .and. &
2993 i <= nvarmax_sfc )
2994 i = i + 1
2995 end do
2996 ntot = i - 1
2997 if ( ntot == nvarmax_sfc ) then
2998 write(fstderr,*) "There are more statistical variables listed in ", &
2999 "clubb_vars_sfc than allowed for by nvarmax_sfc."
3000 write(fstderr,*) "Check the number of variables listed for clubb_vars_sfc ", &
3001 "in the stats namelist, or change nvarmax_sfc."
3002 write(fstderr,*) "nvarmax_sfc = ", nvarmax_sfc
3003 call endrun ("stats_init_clubb: number of sfc statistical variables exceeds limit")
3004 endif
3005
3006 sfc%nn = ntot
3007 sfc%kk = 1
3008
3009 allocate( sfc%z( sfc%kk ) )
3010
3011 allocate( sfc%x( 1, 1, sfc%kk, sfc%nn ) )
3012 allocate( sfc%n( 1, 1, sfc%kk, sfc%nn ) )
3013 allocate( sfc%l_in_update( 1, 1, sfc%kk, sfc%nn ) )
3014
3015 call stats_zero( sfc%kk, sfc%nn, sfc%x, sfc%n, sfc%l_in_update )
3016
3017 allocate( sfc%f%var( sfc%nn ) )
3018 allocate( sfc%f%z( sfc%kk ) )
3019
3020 fname = trim( fname_sfc )
3021
3022 call stats_init_sfc( clubb_vars_sfc, l_error )
3023
3024 ! Check for errors
3025
3026 if ( l_error ) then
3027 call endrun ('stats_init: errors found')
3028 endif
3029
3030! Now call add fields
3031 do i = 1, zt%nn
3032
3033 temp1 = trim(zt%f%var(i)%name)
3034 sub = temp1
3035 if (len(temp1) .gt. 16) sub = temp1(1:16)
3036
3037 call addfld(trim(sub),trim(zt%f%var(i)%units),nnzp,&
3038 'A',trim(zt%f%var(i)%description),phys_decomp)
3039 enddo
3040
3041 do i = 1, zm%nn
3042
3043 temp1 = trim(zm%f%var(i)%name)
3044 sub = temp1
3045 if (len(temp1) .gt. 16) sub = temp1(1:16)
3046
3047 call addfld(trim(sub),trim(zm%f%var(i)%units),nnzp,&
3048 'A',trim(zm%f%var(i)%description),phys_decomp)
3049 enddo
3050
3051 if (l_output_rad_files) then
3052 do i = 1, rad_zt%nn
3053 call addfld(trim(rad_zt%f%var(i)%name),trim(rad_zt%f%var(i)%units),nnzp,&
3054 'A',trim(rad_zt%f%var(i)%description),phys_decomp)
3055 enddo
3056
3057 do i = 1, rad_zm%nn
3058 call addfld(trim(rad_zm%f%var(i)%name),trim(rad_zm%f%var(i)%units),nnzp,&
3059 'A',trim(rad_zm%f%var(i)%description),phys_decomp)
3060 enddo
3061 endif
3062
3063 do i = 1, sfc%nn
3064 call addfld(trim(sfc%f%var(i)%name),trim(sfc%f%var(i)%units),1,&
3065 'A',trim(sfc%f%var(i)%description),phys_decomp)
3066 enddo
3067
3068 return
3069
3070
3071 end subroutine stats_init_clubb
3072
3073#endif

3079
3080 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3081 subroutine stats_end_timestep_clubb(lchnk,thecol,out_zt,out_zm,out_radzt,out_radzm,out_sfc)
3082
3083 ! Description: Called when the stats timestep has ended. This subroutine
3084 ! is responsible for calling statistics to be written to the output
3085 ! format.
3086 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3087
3088#ifdef CLUBB_SGS
3089
3090 use constants_clubb, only: &
3091 fstderr ! Constant(s)
3092
3093 use stats_variables, only: &
3094 zt, & ! Variable(s)
3095 zm, &
3096 rad_zt, &
3097 rad_zm, &
3098 sfc, &
3099 l_stats_last, &
3100 stats_tsamp, &
3101 stats_tout, &
3102 l_output_rad_files
3103
3104 use error_code, only: &
3105 clubb_at_least_debug_level ! Procedure(s)
3106
3107 use cam_history, only: outfld
3108
3109 use ppgrid, only: pcols, pverp
3110
3111 use cam_abortutils, only: endrun
3112
3113 implicit none
3114
3115
3116#endif
3117
3118 integer :: lchnk
3119 integer :: thecol
3120
3121 real(r8), intent(inout) :: out_zt(:,:,:) ! (pcols,pverp,zt%nn)
3122 real(r8), intent(inout) :: out_zm(:,:,:) ! (pcols,pverp,zt%nn)
3123 real(r8), intent(inout) :: out_radzt(:,:,:) ! (pcols,pverp,rad_zt%nn)
3124 real(r8), intent(inout) :: out_radzm(:,:,:) ! (pcols,pverp,rad_zm%nn)
3125 real(r8), intent(inout) :: out_sfc(:,:,:) ! (pcols,1,sfc%nn)
3126
3127#ifdef CLUBB_SGS
3128 ! Local Variables
3129
3130 integer :: i, k
3131 logical :: l_error
3132
3133 ! Check if it is time to write to file
3134
3135 if ( .not. l_stats_last ) return
3136
3137 ! Initialize
3138 l_error = .false.
3139
3140 ! Look for errors by checking the number of sampling points
3141 ! for each variable in the zt statistics at each vertical level.
3142 do i = 1, zt%nn
3143 do k = 1, zt%kk
3144
3145 if ( zt%n(1,1,k,i) /= 0 .and. &
3146 zt%n(1,1,k,i) /= floor(stats_tout/stats_tsamp) ) then
3147
3148 l_error = .true. ! This will stop the run
3149
3150 if ( clubb_at_least_debug_level( 1 ) ) then
3151 write(fstderr,*) 'Possible sampling error for variable ', &
3152 trim(zt%f%var(i)%name), ' in zt ', &
3153 'at k = ', k, &
3154 '; zt%n(',k,',',i,') = ', zt%n(1,1,k,i)
3155 endif
3156
3157 endif
3158
3159 enddo
3160 enddo
3161
3162 ! Look for errors by checking the number of sampling points
3163 ! for each variable in the zm statistics at each vertical level.
3164 do i = 1, zm%nn
3165 do k = 1, zm%kk
3166
3167 if ( zm%n(1,1,k,i) /= 0 .and. &
3168 zm%n(1,1,k,i) /= floor(stats_tout/stats_tsamp) ) then
3169
3170 l_error = .true. ! This will stop the run
3171
3172 if ( clubb_at_least_debug_level( 1 ) ) then
3173 write(fstderr,*) 'Possible sampling error for variable ', &
3174 trim(zm%f%var(i)%name), ' in zm ', &
3175 'at k = ', k, &
3176 '; zm%n(',k,',',i,') = ', zm%n(1,1,k,i)
3177 endif
3178
3179 endif
3180
3181 enddo
3182 enddo
3183
3184 if (l_output_rad_files) then
3185 ! Look for errors by checking the number of sampling points
3186 ! for each variable in the rad_zt statistics at each vertical level.
3187 do i = 1, rad_zt%nn
3188 do k = 1, rad_zt%kk
3189
3190 if ( rad_zt%n(1,1,k,i) /= 0 .and. &
3191 rad_zt%n(1,1,k,i) /= floor(stats_tout/stats_tsamp) ) then
3192
3193 l_error = .true. ! This will stop the run
3194
3195 if ( clubb_at_least_debug_level( 1 ) ) then
3196 write(fstderr,*) 'Possible sampling error for variable ', &
3197 trim(rad_zt%f%var(i)%name), ' in rad_zt ', &
3198 'at k = ', k, &
3199 '; rad_zt%n(',k,',',i,') = ', rad_zt%n(1,1,k,i)
3200 endif
3201
3202 endif
3203
3204 enddo
3205 enddo
3206
3207 ! Look for errors by checking the number of sampling points
3208 ! for each variable in the rad_zm statistics at each vertical level.
3209 do i = 1, rad_zm%nn
3210 do k = 1, rad_zm%kk
3211
3212 if ( rad_zm%n(1,1,k,i) /= 0 .and. &
3213 rad_zm%n(1,1,k,i) /= floor(stats_tout/stats_tsamp) ) then
3214
3215 l_error = .true. ! This will stop the run
3216
3217 if ( clubb_at_least_debug_level( 1 ) ) then
3218 write(fstderr,*) 'Possible sampling error for variable ', &
3219 trim(rad_zm%f%var(i)%name), ' in rad_zm ', &
3220 'at k = ', k, &
3221 '; rad_zm%n(',k,',',i,') = ', rad_zm%n(1,1,k,i)
3222 endif
3223
3224 endif
3225
3226 enddo
3227 enddo
3228 end if ! l_output_rad_files
3229
3230 ! Look for errors by checking the number of sampling points
3231 ! for each variable in the sfc statistics at each vertical level.
3232 do i = 1, sfc%nn
3233 do k = 1, sfc%kk
3234
3235 if ( sfc%n(1,1,k,i) /= 0 .and. &
3236 sfc%n(1,1,k,i) /= floor(stats_tout/stats_tsamp) ) then
3237
3238 l_error = .true. ! This will stop the run
3239
3240 if ( clubb_at_least_debug_level( 1 ) ) then
3241 write(fstderr,*) 'Possible sampling error for variable ', &
3242 trim(sfc%f%var(i)%name), ' in sfc ', &
3243 'at k = ', k, &
3244 '; sfc%n(',k,',',i,') = ', sfc%n(1,1,k,i)
3245 endif
3246
3247 endif
3248
3249 enddo
3250 enddo
3251
3252 ! Stop the run if errors are found.
3253 if ( l_error ) then
3254 write(fstderr,*) 'Possible statistical sampling error'
3255 write(fstderr,*) 'For details, set debug_level to a value of at ', &
3256 'least 1 in the appropriate model.in file.'
3257 call endrun ('stats_end_timestep: error(s) found')
3258 endif
3259
3260 ! Compute averages
3261 call stats_avg( zt%kk, zt%nn, zt%x, zt%n )
3262 call stats_avg( zm%kk, zm%nn, zm%x, zm%n )
3263 if (l_output_rad_files) then
3264 call stats_avg( rad_zt%kk, rad_zt%nn, rad_zt%x, rad_zt%n )
3265 call stats_avg( rad_zm%kk, rad_zm%nn, rad_zm%x, rad_zm%n )
3266 end if
3267 call stats_avg( sfc%kk, sfc%nn, sfc%x, sfc%n )
3268
3269 ! Here we are not outputting the data, rather reading the stats into
3270 ! arrays which are conformable to CAM output. Also, the data is "flipped"
3271 ! in the vertical level to be the same as CAM output.
3272 do i = 1, zt%nn
3273 do k = 1, zt%kk
3274 out_zt(thecol,k,i) = zt%x(1,1,zt%kk-k+1,i)
3275 if(out_zt(thecol,k,i) .ne. out_zt(thecol,k,i)) out_zt(thecol,k,i) = 0.0_r8
3276 enddo
3277 enddo
3278
3279 do i = 1, zm%nn
3280 do k = 1, zt%kk
3281 out_zm(thecol,k,i) = zm%x(1,1,zt%kk-k+1,i)
3282 if(out_zm(thecol,k,i) .ne. out_zm(thecol,k,i)) out_zm(thecol,k,i) = 0.0_r8
3283 enddo
3284 enddo
3285
3286 if (l_output_rad_files) then
3287 do i = 1, rad_zt%nn
3288 do k = 1, rad_zt%kk
3289 out_radzt(thecol,k,i) = rad_zt%x(1,1,zt%kk-k+1,i)
3290 if(out_radzt(thecol,k,i) .ne. out_radzt(thecol,k,i)) out_radzt(thecol,k,i) = 0.0_r8
3291 enddo
3292 enddo
3293
3294 do i = 1, rad_zm%nn
3295 do k = 1, rad_zm%kk
3296 out_radzm(thecol,k,i) = rad_zm%x(1,1,zt%kk-k+1,i)
3297 if(out_radzm(thecol,k,i) .ne. out_radzm(thecol,k,i)) out_radzm(thecol,k,i) = 0.0_r8
3298 enddo
3299 enddo
3300 endif
3301
3302 do i = 1, sfc%nn
3303 out_sfc(thecol,1,i) = sfc%x(1,1,1,i)
3304 if(out_sfc(thecol,1,i) .ne. out_sfc(thecol,1,i)) out_sfc(thecol,1,i) = 0.0_r8
3305 enddo
3306
3307 ! Reset sample fields
3308 call stats_zero( zt%kk, zt%nn, zt%x, zt%n, zt%l_in_update )
3309 call stats_zero( zm%kk, zm%nn, zm%x, zm%n, zm%l_in_update )
3310 if (l_output_rad_files) then
3311 call stats_zero( rad_zt%kk, rad_zt%nn, rad_zt%x, rad_zt%n, rad_zt%l_in_update )
3312 call stats_zero( rad_zm%kk, rad_zm%nn, rad_zm%x, rad_zm%n, rad_zm%l_in_update )
3313 end if
3314 call stats_zero( sfc%kk, sfc%nn, sfc%x, sfc%n, sfc%l_in_update )
3315
3316
3317 return
3318
3319#endif
3320
3321 end subroutine stats_end_timestep_clubb
3322
3323
3324 ! =============================================================================== !
3325 ! !
3326 ! =============================================================================== !
3327
3328#ifdef CLUBB_SGS
3329
3330 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3331 subroutine stats_zero( kk, nn, x, n, l_in_update )
3332
3333 ! Description:
3334 ! Initialize stats to zero
3335 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3336
3337 use clubb_precision, only: &
3338 stat_rknd, & ! Variable(s)
3339 stat_nknd
3340
3341
3342 implicit none
3343
3344 ! Input
3345 integer, intent(in) :: kk, nn
3346
3347 ! Output
3348 real(kind=stat_rknd), dimension(1,1,kk,nn), intent(out) :: x
3349 integer(kind=stat_nknd), dimension(1,1,kk,nn), intent(out) :: n
3350 logical, dimension(1,1,kk,nn), intent(out) :: l_in_update
3351
3352 ! Zero out arrays
3353
3354 if ( nn > 0 ) then
3355 x(:,:,:,:) = 0.0_r8
3356 n(:,:,:,:) = 0
3357 l_in_update(:,:,:,:) = .false.
3358 end if
3359
3360 return
3361
3362 end subroutine stats_zero
3363
3364#endif
3365
3366 ! =============================================================================== !
3367 ! !
3368 ! =============================================================================== !
3369
3370
3371#ifdef CLUBB_SGS
3372 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3373 subroutine stats_avg( kk, nn, x, n )
3374
3375 ! Description:
3376 ! Compute the average of stats fields
3377 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3378 use clubb_precision, only: &
3379 stat_rknd, & ! Variable(s)
3380 stat_nknd
3381
3382 implicit none
3383
3384 ! Input
3385 integer, intent(in) :: nn, kk
3386 integer(kind=stat_nknd), dimension(1,1,kk,nn), intent(in) :: n
3387
3388 ! Output
3389 real(kind=stat_rknd), dimension(1,1,kk,nn), intent(inout) :: x
3390
3391 ! Internal
3392
3393 integer k,m
3394
3395 ! Compute averages
3396
3397 do m=1,nn
3398 do k=1,kk
3399
3400 if ( n(1,1,k,m) > 0 ) then
3401 x(1,1,k,m) = x(1,1,k,m) / real( n(1,1,k,m) )
3402 end if
3403
3404 end do
3405 end do
3406
3407 return
3408
3409 end subroutine stats_avg
3410
3411#endif
3412
3413end module clubb_intr
